title: Customer Care Analyst
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Customer Care Analyst em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Do you have a proven track record in customer service within a technical environment? Are you experienced in sales and billing management, providing technical support and handling after-sales support? Are you self-driven and goal oriented, with a strong technical background and a passion for technology, innovation and sustainability?  At DEIF, we are currently looking for a full-time Customer Care Analyst based in Campinas, Brazil.    DEIF A/S is a worldwide leader in power efficiency, and we are on a journey to make a real difference in the world. We pursue an ambitious growth strategy and want to be a global trendsetter in power efficient products and solutions. We aim to be the go-to partner for efficient power management, renowned for our intelligent platforms and smart solutions.     About The Job    The Customer Care Analyst will serve as a key point of contact, delivering consistent, high-quality, and world-class technical customer service to our clients.    This role requires excellent communication skills and a collaborative, solution-oriented mindset. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment while maintaining composure and professionalism. A strong understanding of business needs is essential, along with the ability to contribute to a team dedicated to solving complex customer challenges.    Working Tasks and Responsibilities    Supporting all post-sales activities.   Successfully and timely booking and lifecycle handling of all quotations.   Handling incoming calls/inquiries from prospects, customers and leads.   Providing customers with technical support, general product and service information.   Serving as the primary customer contact and ensuring all customer needs and expectations are met.   Ensuring strict adherence to business processes and controls to ensure best-in-class customer service and seamless order management fulfillment.   Collaborating with other departments such as technical support, sales managers, product managers, etc.   Handling purchasing orders, logistics and inventory.   Ensuring good document control and setting up new customers in CRM and updating existing records as needed.   Identifying, investigating, and resolving customer needs using the database/ERP system.   You will support ordering processing including monitoring order status and resolving discrepancies/complains if needed.     What You’ll Bring    Education in Electronics/Industrial/Automation or Engineering or related field. Business education is also acceptable.   Experience in customer service, sales environment and/or technical procedures.   Passionate about customer service and customer-centric approach.   Ability to communicate in English – both writing and speaking.   Self-motivated, with excellent communication skills.   Well-organized, with a hand-on/proactive approach and a strong team player.   Good understanding of the importance of health and safety in the workplace.     Cover letters are encouraged as part of your application.    At DEIF, we are Winning Together!   We promise you'll experience a culture based on values such as Ambitions, Perspective, and Respect, where we are Winning Together. We are a global company and work in many different locations – however, we are all united by a wish to make our customers and colleagues succeed. You'll experience a highly professional work environment where continuous learning, empowerment, and collaboration is essential.    We are in a continuous process of developing new intelligent products and solutions that can contribute to accelerating the green transition. Sustainability is central to our business, and we have recently been recognized in the EY Entrepreneur of The Year 2023, where we won the award in the ESG category.    Curious to learn more about the benefits of working at DEIF? Delve into the details by visiting our career page at  .

title: Network Operations Center Technician
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Network Operations Center Technician em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

SOC / NOC Technician (L1) — LATAM  Acceleronix | Customer Support / Network Operations | LATAM    Location   : Campinas, Brazil    Role Overview     We are expanding our  Customer Support function into a 24/7 operation   and are looking for a  SOC / NOC Technician (L1)  to support real-time monitoring, incident detection, ticket management, and escalation across our  platform and connectivity environments   .   This role is the first operational layer for identifying issues, validating alerts, following playbooks, and escalating incidents to L2 or engineering teams with clear context. The focus is mainly on  platform, APIs, connectivity, SIM/network behavior, and service availability   . Device-level troubleshooting will be handled by L2.    Key Responsibilities     Monitor platform and connectivity environments in real time, including  APIs, service availability, device telemetry, SIM status, and network behavior   .   Identify anomalies, validate alerts, and distinguish false positives from real incidents.   Classify incidents by domain:  platform, connectivity, or device-related   .   Follow predefined playbooks for common operational issues.   Perform first-level diagnosis to identify whether the issue is related to API/backend, SIM/network/roaming, or device configuration.   Create, update, and manage incident tickets in  Fresh service or similar tools   .   Ensure proper ticket categorization, SLA tracking, and timely updates.   Escalate incidents to L2, engineering, Customer Support, Solution Architects, or Connectivity/Carrier teams with structured information.   Maintain accurate shift logs and support smooth handovers between LATAM, EMEA, and APAC teams.   Highlight ongoing incidents, risks, and urgent operational priorities during shift transitions.     Required Qualifications     Bachelor’s degree in  Telecommunications, Computer Science, Information Technology   , or a related field. Equivalent practical experience may also be considered.  1–3 years of experience   in technical support, NOC/SOC, network operations, or IT operations.   Foundational understanding of  mobile networks, SIM lifecycle, and connectivity concepts   .   Basic knowledge of  APIs, monitoring tools, and log analysis   .   Exposure to cloud environments;  AWS basics preferred   .   Ability to follow structured troubleshooting steps and interpret system behavior.   Comfortable working  rotational shifts and on-call rotations   .   Native/fluent Portuguese and professional English required   .   Spanish is a strong plus for LATAM coordination.     Preferred Qualifications     Experience with telecom operators, MVNOs, IoT platforms, or connectivity providers.   Previous NOC/SOC L1 or L2 experience.   Experience with ticketing tools such as  Fresh service, ServiceNow, or Jira Service Management   .   Certifications such as  CCNA, CompTIA Network+, Security+, JNCIA, AZ-900  , or similar are preferred but not mandatory.     Soft Skills     Detail-oriented, structured, and reliable.   Calm under pressure.   Strong ownership and accountability.   Quick learner with strong pattern-recognition ability.   Global mindset and collaborative approach.   Technician mindset with interest in IT operations, systems, and network reliability.     About Acceleronix     Acceleronix is a global IoT solutions and services enablement provider, part of the  Quectel  ecosystem, dedicated to accelerating IoT projects for OEMs and enterprises worldwide. We deliver an integrated portfolio that includes an end-to-end IoT platform, edge-device management software, Connectivity-as-a-Service (eSIM, iSIM, vSIM), vertical software, mobile applications, and full-lifecycle cellular and satellite connectivity — empowering customers to build smarter, more efficient solutions while reducing complexity, eliminating risk, and speeding up time-to-market.   With pan-regional R&D teams and expert support across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM, Acceleronix is expanding its footprint in Latin America to serve a rapidly growing base of IoT innovators across smart metering, asset tracking, smart agriculture, connected mobility, and Industry 4.0.    Life at Acceleronix LATAM     At Acceleronix LATAM, no two days are the same. You'll collaborate with a diverse, globally-connected team, engage directly with some of the most innovative OEMs and enterprises in Latin America, and contribute to technologies that are redefining how devices and people connect.   Fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment backed by the resources of a global IoT leader and the Quectel ecosystem   Direct access to global R&D, product, and engineering teams across Asia, Europe, and the Americas   Regular knowledge-sharing through internal Masterclasses, webinars, and cross-functional project teams   A culture of continuous learning — we invest in your growth because your development is our development     Industries & Applications     Acceleronix's IoT solutions power innovation across a wide range of industries. As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact in:   Smart Metering & Utilities — Electricity, water, and gas metering solutions   Asset Tracking & Logistics — Fleet management, cold chain, and supply chain visibility   Smart Agriculture — Precision farming, greenhouse monitoring, and livestock tracking   Smart Cities & Infrastructure — Street lighting, parking, public safety, environmental monitoring   Industrial IoT & Automation — Predictive maintenance, factory automation, condition monitoring   Connected Mobility & Automotive — Telematics, EV charging, micro-mobility   Smart Home & Consumer IoT — Connected appliances, energy management, security     Why Acceleronix LATAM?    Global Impact, Regional Focus —   Be at the forefront of IoT innovation across Latin America, backed by a global organization with teams in APAC, EMEA, and North America.   Career Growth & Development —   Access structured mentorship, international exposure, internal mobility, and clear advancement paths within a fast-growing global organization.   Cutting-Edge Technology —   Work on next-generation IoT platforms, cellular connectivity, eSIM/iSIM, and edge-to-cloud solutions deployed in mission-critical applications.   Diversity & Inclusion —   Join an inclusive, multicultural workplace where diverse perspectives are valued as key drivers of innovation and success.   Global Team & Collaboration —   Collaborate with a global network of IoT experts across engineering, sales, marketing, and operations — and with the Quectel ecosystem.     Compensation & Benefits     Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks   Performance bonus/sales commission structure (role dependent)  Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance)  Health insurance with no co-pay   Life insurance   Paid time off   International travel opportunities (HQ visits, global trade shows)    Explore Acceleronix — Links & Resources     We encourage all candidates to learn more about Acceleronix before applying. The links below will give you a full picture of who we are, what we build, and what it's like to work here.    Company & Careers     Company Website:   —  Products, solutions, and company overview    Connectivity Platform:   acceleronix.io/products/connectivity-management-platform  —  Our IoT connectivity management platform    Quectel (Parent Ecosystem):   —  Global IoT solutions provider    Quectel Careers:   quectel.com/about-quectel/career  —  Open roles across the Quectel ecosystem    Quectel News & Press:   quectel.com/news-and-pr  —  Latest company announcements     Follow Us on Social Media     LinkedIn:   Acceleronix  —  Company updates, job posts, industry news    LinkedIn (Quectel):   Quectel Wireless Solutions  —  Global Quectel updates and news    YouTube:   Quectel on YouTube  —  Product demos, tech talks, and event highlights     Technical & Developer Resources     Quectel Developer Zone:   developer.quectel.com  —  Docs, SDKs, tools, and developer support    Acceleronix Masterclass:   Guide to the Acceleronix IoT Platform  —  On-demand platform walkthrough and training    Product Selector:   quectel.com/product-selector  —  Browse the full portfolio of IoT modules and antennas     Acceleronix is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic.

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION:    The Consolidation Specialist contributes to the production of Imerys' quarterly consolidated financial statements in accordance with IFRS standards, by overseeing the financial statements of the Americas subsidiaries with the Americas Consolidation Manager, and producing Group analyses in coordination with the Group Consolidation team (totalling 9 people), spread across Paris, Brussels, Singapore, and Campinas, covering overall a scope of approximately 220 entities spread across some fifty countries. Group analyses    - Contribute to global Group topics, including IFRS 16 (Leases) reviews, mining accounting issues, and other specific key performance indicators.    One-off items    - Assist units in preparing for quarterly closings by anticipating the IFRS treatment of specific transactions according to the Group accounting manual.  - Support Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A), divestitures, or internal mergers within the Americas scope.  - Define solutions to improve processes, reporting timelines, and the reliability of consolidated data.    OTHER IMPORTANT FUNCTIONS:    The position includes regular discussions with external auditors regarding the Americas scope and assistance with internal audit requirements. Previous experience in auditing is highly desirable.    REQUIREMENTS:    Education:   Bachelor’s degree in Accounting (Certified Accountant).   Experience:   Minimum of 5 to 7 years in accounting, with a strong focus on consolidation and external auditing.   Languages:   Fluent English (mandatory for writing and speaking) and advanced Spanish (desirable).    Know-how, skills, abilities and other characteristics:     Technical Skills:   Proficiency in Google and Microsoft applications (especially Excel); experience with financial software and databases such as SAP BFC (reporting tool - desirable), SAP 4HANA (desirable) and Anaplan (desirable).   Soft Skills:   Team player, ability to build trust-based relationships with peers and international contacts, and focus on continuous improvement.   Essential Qualities:   Organized, strict adherence to deadlines, analytical mindset, autonomy, transparency, and a proactive attitude toward learning.    In commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, this opportunity is also aimed at candidates with disabilities.

title: Network Operations Center Technician
description:

SOC / NOC Technician (L1) — LATAM Acceleronix | Customer Support / Network Operations | LATAM  Location : Campinas, Brazil Role Overview   We are expanding our Customer Support function into a 24/7 operation  and are looking for a SOC / NOC Technician (L1)  to support real-time monitoring, incident detection, ticket management, and escalation across our platform and connectivity environments . This role is the first operational layer for identifying issues, validating alerts, following playbooks, and escalating incidents to L2 or engineering teams with clear context. The focus is mainly on platform, APIs, connectivity, SIM/network behavior, and service availability . Device-level troubleshooting will be handled by L2. Key Responsibilities   Monitor platform and connectivity environments in real time, including APIs, service availability, device telemetry, SIM status, and network behavior . Identify anomalies, validate alerts, and distinguish false positives from real incidents. Classify incidents by domain: platform, connectivity, or device-related . Follow predefined playbooks for common operational issues. Perform first-level diagnosis to identify whether the issue is related to API/backend, SIM/network/roaming, or device configuration. Create, update, and manage incident tickets in Fresh service or similar tools . Ensure proper ticket categorization, SLA tracking, and timely updates. Escalate incidents to L2, engineering, Customer Support, Solution Architects, or Connectivity/Carrier teams with structured information. Maintain accurate shift logs and support smooth handovers between LATAM, EMEA, and APAC teams. Highlight ongoing incidents, risks, and urgent operational priorities during shift transitions.  Required Qualifications   Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Computer Science, Information Technology , or a related field. Equivalent practical experience may also be considered. 1–3 years of experience  in technical support, NOC/SOC, network operations, or IT operations. Foundational understanding of mobile networks, SIM lifecycle, and connectivity concepts . Basic knowledge of APIs, monitoring tools, and log analysis . Exposure to cloud environments; AWS basics preferred . Ability to follow structured troubleshooting steps and interpret system behavior. Comfortable working rotational shifts and on-call rotations . Native/fluent Portuguese and professional English required . Spanish is a strong plus for LATAM coordination.  Preferred Qualifications   Experience with telecom operators, MVNOs, IoT platforms, or connectivity providers. Previous NOC/SOC L1 or L2 experience. Experience with ticketing tools such as Fresh service, ServiceNow, or Jira Service Management . Certifications such as CCNA, CompTIA Network+, Security+, JNCIA, AZ-900 , or similar are preferred but not mandatory.  Soft Skills   Detail-oriented, structured, and reliable. Calm under pressure. Strong ownership and accountability. Quick learner with strong pattern-recognition ability. Global mindset and collaborative approach. Technician mindset with interest in IT operations, systems, and network reliability.  About Acceleronix   Acceleronix is a global IoT solutions and services enablement provider, part of the Quectel  ecosystem, dedicated to accelerating IoT projects for OEMs and enterprises worldwide. We deliver an integrated portfolio that includes an end-to-end IoT platform, edge-device management software, Connectivity-as-a-Service (eSIM, iSIM, vSIM), vertical software, mobile applications, and full-lifecycle cellular and satellite connectivity — empowering customers to build smarter, more efficient solutions while reducing complexity, eliminating risk, and speeding up time-to-market. With pan-regional R&D teams and expert support across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM, Acceleronix is expanding its footprint in Latin America to serve a rapidly growing base of IoT innovators across smart metering, asset tracking, smart agriculture, connected mobility, and Industry 4.0. Life at Acceleronix LATAM   At Acceleronix LATAM, no two days are the same. You'll collaborate with a diverse, globally-connected team, engage directly with some of the most innovative OEMs and enterprises in Latin America, and contribute to technologies that are redefining how devices and people connect. Fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment backed by the resources of a global IoT leader and the Quectel ecosystem Direct access to global R&D, product, and engineering teams across Asia, Europe, and the Americas Regular knowledge-sharing through internal Masterclasses, webinars, and cross-functional project teams A culture of continuous learning — we invest in your growth because your development is our development  Industries & Applications   Acceleronix's IoT solutions power innovation across a wide range of industries. As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact in: Smart Metering & Utilities — Electricity, water, and gas metering solutions Asset Tracking & Logistics — Fleet management, cold chain, and supply chain visibility Smart Agriculture — Precision farming, greenhouse monitoring, and livestock tracking Smart Cities & Infrastructure — Street lighting, parking, public safety, environmental monitoring Industrial IoT & Automation — Predictive maintenance, factory automation, condition monitoring Connected Mobility & Automotive — Telematics, EV charging, micro-mobility Smart Home & Consumer IoT — Connected appliances, energy management, security  Why Acceleronix LATAM?   Global Impact, Regional Focus —  Be at the forefront of IoT innovation across Latin America, backed by a global organization with teams in APAC, EMEA, and North America. Career Growth & Development —  Access structured mentorship, international exposure, internal mobility, and clear advancement paths within a fast-growing global organization. Cutting-Edge Technology —  Work on next-generation IoT platforms, cellular connectivity, eSIM/iSIM, and edge-to-cloud solutions deployed in mission-critical applications. Diversity & Inclusion —  Join an inclusive, multicultural workplace where diverse perspectives are valued as key drivers of innovation and success. Global Team & Collaboration —  Collaborate with a global network of IoT experts across engineering, sales, marketing, and operations — and with the Quectel ecosystem.  Compensation & Benefits   Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks Performance bonus/sales commission structure (role dependent) Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance) Health insurance with no co-pay Life insurance Paid time off International travel opportunities (HQ visits, global trade shows)  Explore Acceleronix — Links & Resources   We encourage all candidates to learn more about Acceleronix before applying. description:

Role Overview   Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company's foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.   Key Responsibilities   Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)   Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes. Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes. Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations. Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools. Automation, Integration & AI Implementation   Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our Saa S ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, Java Script). Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks. Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software. IT Administration & Security   Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365). Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access. Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security. Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate Saa S contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl. Required Qualifications & Skills   Technical Experience:   5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration. Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment. Strong understanding of cloud-based Saa S ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures. High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting. Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows. Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols. Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:   Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity. Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms. Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions. title: Regional study director, latam
description:

This is an exciting time to join Crinetics as we expand our operations in Latin America and shape our organization into the world's premier fully integrated endocrine company from discovery to patients. Join our team as we transform the lives of others.   Position Summary:   Please note, the candidate for this role will need to be located in Brazil.   The Regional Study Director, LATAM is responsible for managing the execution of clinical studies and data collection within the LATAM region. The incumbent will serve as a regional clinical study lead who oversees the review, monitoring, and adherence to clinical protocols, as well as managing and building relationships with clinical sites in LATAM. The Regional Study Director, LATAM may oversee other regional study leads within the region to facilitate a streamlined and quality study execution. This role will also work internally and externally with members of the cross-functional study team.   Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities:   These may include but are not limited to:   Provide oversight of clinical research studies for LATAM. Manage and build relationships with clinical research sites in LATAM. May oversee the work of other regional study leads within LATAM. Provide operational and strategic input into study documents such as synopsis, protocol, ICF, CRFs, CRF Completion Guidelines, Study Execution Plans, Clinical Data Review Plan, Clinical Database edit specifications, Clinical Study Report (CSR) development, etc. Oversight of all regional vendors and activities including CROs. Oversee regional start up activities including site selection, enrollment projections and activities driving site activation. Develop region specific the subject recruitment/retention strategy and related initiatives. Oversight of regional TMF ongoing quality review, and final reconciliation of study documents including review of site regulatory documents/packages and obtaining of appropriate site insurance, and/or supervision of team members performing these activities. Development of training materials for study team, investigational sites, and vendors. Proactive management of information sharing with key stakeholders using standardized reports and other mechanisms. Assure clinical studies are compliant with GDPR, ICH/GCP and other regulations as appropriate. Outline regional activation hurdles for team. Participate in RFP development and prepare bid templates to facilitate selection of the CROs/vendors, and/or collaboration/supervision with team members performing these activities. Collaborate with counsel to negotiate and draft research contracts and agreements with CROs/vendors and clinical study sites, as needed. Acts as liaison with Regulatory Affairs to assure adherence to GDPR, GCPs; maintenance of SOPs; and assure site and CRO/vendor audits are completed. Perform regional risk management and implement mitigations. Identify potential study issues and recommend and implement solutions or corrective actions as needed. Create realistic plans that clearly define goals, milestones, responsibilities, and results. Maintain focus on strategic objectives while accomplishing operational goals. Make timely, data-driven decisions. Manage daily activities, assign tasks, goals, and development of direct reports. Other duties as assigned. Required Education and Experience:   Bachelor's degree required, preferably in scientific discipline. An equivalent combination of relevant education and applicable job experience may be considered. 12 years of prior clinical operations experience preferably with CRO/small biotech experience and approximately 8 years of experience in a supervisory role. Must be able to travel 25-50% of time, may be higher in accordance with project requirements. Computer skills should include proficiency with Microsoft Office suite of software, electronic TMF systems, IXRS and EDC systems. Excellent understanding of drug development process. Experience in clinical trial supply management. Able to make appropriate decisions to move the project(s) forward. Effective verbal and written communication skills. Data flow from sites to data processing, review, and resolution. Analysis and report generation. Knowledge of local regulatory requirements. Ability to handle multiple tasks to meet deadlines in a dynamic environment is essential. Study initiation procedures. Ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action Travel:   You may be required to travel for up to 25-50% of your time.

title: Full stack engineer
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Full stack engineer em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Freight Hero   Freight Hero is an AI-native services company built to support the freight brokerage industry, which is in dire need of it. Robin, our autonomous AI agent, handles back-office work end to end. Our Heroes, a sharp human-in-the-loop team, catch the edge cases. Brokers pay us per load, see ROI in weeks, and reassign or eliminate the teams they used to rent.   We are backed by incredible investors, including Andrew Ng's AI Fund and supply chain specialists Dynamo Ventures.   The thesis is proven. What is next is growth, and that means building a team of incredible people around us to push the company to the next level. The product is real, the customers are real, the revenue is real, and joining now means shaping how this company runs.   About the Role   This is a senior full‐stack engineering role focused on building and scaling the core Freight Hero platform. You will work across backend services, integrations, internal tools, and customer-facing features, primarily using Node.js, Type Script, React, and AWS.   You won't be inheriting a legacy monolith. You'll be contributing to a modern, event‐driven, AI‐powered system and helping us scale it as customer adoption accelerates.   You'll collaborate closely with product, AI, and customer teams to translate real operational workflows into robust, reliable software. As the team grows, you'll have opportunities to mentor others, influence architecture, and shape engineering best practices.   What Success Looks Like   A successful engineer in this role:   Builds scalable, reliable services in Node.js/Type Script that integrate deeply with customer systems. Designs and maintains AWS‐native infrastructure that is observable, secure, and cost‐efficient. Works cross‐functionally to understand customer workflows and translate them into technical solutions. Ships high‐quality features quickly while maintaining engineering excellence. Identifies opportunities to automate, optimize, and expand the platform. Contributes to a culture of ownership, clarity, and continuous improvement. Key Responsibilities:   Full Stack Engineering   Build backend services, APIs, and workflow engines using Node.js + Type Script. Contribute to frontend components when needed using React + Vue JS. Implement robust testing, observability, and CI/CD practices. AWS native Architecture   Design and maintain cloud infrastructure using AWS services such as Lambda, RDS, Dynamo DB, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, and more. Ensure systems are scalable, secure, and cost‐optimized. Systems Integration   Build integrations with TMS platforms, carrier systems, and customer‐specific tools. Work with internal teams to understand operational processes and translate them into scalable technical solutions.   AI Forward Development   Collaborate with AI engineers to embed LLM‐powered workflows into the product. Use AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, and automate repetitive tasks. Identify opportunities to expand AI‐driven automation across the platform.   Collaboration & Impact   Work closely with product, operations, and customer success to deeply understand customer needs. Participate in technical discussions, architectural decisions, and roadmap planning. Help establish engineering best practices as the team grows. What We Are Looking For   8+ years of professional software engineering experience. Strong expertise in Node.js, Type Script, React, and AWS cloud architecture. Experience building distributed systems, event‐driven architectures, or workflow automation. Comfortable working across the stack (backend‐heavy, but able to contribute to frontend). Strong communicator who collaborates well with non‐technical teams. High ownership mindset - you thrive in fast‐moving, ambiguous environments. Curiosity about AI and eagerness to leverage it in your day‐to‐day work. Bonus: experience in freight tech, logistics, or integrations with TMS/ERP systems. Why Freight Hero   Built at the intersection of AI and logistics, one of the most impactful spaces in B2 B tech. Work with a team that moves fast, thinks big, and cares deeply about customer outcomes. Opportunities to mentor, influence architecture, and grow as the engineering team scales. Competitive compensation with performance incentives. Fully remote with a collaborative, high‐performance culture.

Aqui, somos protagonistas o tempo todo, sempre com integridade e ética em tudo o que fazemos. A paixão pela nossa gente é o que nos move, e a dedicação total ao cliente é o nosso compromisso diário. Entregamos resultados e buscamos sempre a simplicidade em tudo o que fazemos!   Buscamos um(a) Especialista em Governança de Dados para estruturar, evoluir e operacionalizar o framework de governança da nossa Plataforma de Dados. Este papel é fundamental para garantir que os dados da companhia sejam confiáveis, descobríveis, seguros e em conformidade — transformando governança de um requisito de compliance em um habilitador de valor para o negócio.   Mais do que definir políticas e padrões, este papel exige profundidade técnica em plataformas modernas de dados, visão sistêmica do ciclo de vida do dado e capacidade de implementar governança de forma prática e escalável, embarcada na esteira de desenvolvimento. O objetivo é elevar a maturidade de governança da companhia, tornando-a um diferencial competitivo sustentado por automação e cultura.   Responsabilidades   Atuar diretamente na definição, evolução e operacionalização do framework corporativo de Governança de Dados da plataforma. Definir, manter e disseminar políticas, padrões e processos relacionados à governança de dados, incluindo: Catalogação, Classificação, Qualidade de dados, Linhagem, Ciclo de vida do dado; Gestão de acessos. Estruturar e evoluir o catálogo corporativo de dados, garantindo descoberta, documentação, rastreabilidade e contexto de negócio para os ativos de dados. Implementar e governar controles de qualidade de dados, incluindo: Definição de regras; Monitoramento contínuo; Alertas e Processos de remediação. Liderar iniciativas de classificação e proteção de dados sensíveis e pessoais, assegurando conformidade com LGPD e demais regulamentações aplicáveis. Atuar com visão ponta a ponta do ecossistema de dados, compreendendo: Fluxos de dados em arquiteturas modernas (Bronze → Silver → Gold); Linhagem e gestão ativa de metadados; Controles de acesso e segregação de dados; Técnicas de mascaramento, anonimização e proteção de dados. Definir e operacionalizar papéis e responsabilidades de governança: Data Owners; Data Stewards e Custodiantes. Integrar práticas de governança à esteira de desenvolvimento de dados, automatizando controles e reduzindo fricção para os times de engenharia. Atuar em parceria com Segurança da Informação, Privacidade, Jurídico e Compliance em temas relacionados a auditoria, conformidade e resposta a incidentes. Apoiar demandas regulatórias, auditorias e requisições relacionadas a titulares de dados. Definir, acompanhar e comunicar métricas e indicadores de: Maturidade de governança; Qualidade de dados. Promover cultura orientada a dados e disseminar boas práticas de governança na organização, atuando como referência técnica no tema. Requisitos e Qualificações   Experiência consolidada em Governança de Dados, preferencialmente em: Ambientes de alta complexidade técnica; Contextos com múltiplos stakeholders; Plataformas analíticas, Data Lake, Data Warehouse ou arquiteturas Lakehouse. Conhecimento sólido e aplicado em: Catalogação, classificação e gestão de metadados; Qualidade, linhagem e ciclo de vida de dados; Gestão de acessos e proteção de dados sensíveis; LGPD e frameworks de governança e privacidade, como DAMA-DMBOK, ISO 27001 e SOC 2. Experiência atuando em conjunto com: Engenharia de Dados; Analytics; Segurança da Informação; Privacidade. Capacidade de implementar governança de forma prática; automatizada; integrada aos processos. Forte habilidade para: traduzir requisitos regulatórios em controles técnicos aplicáveis; definir métricas e acompanhar evolução de maturidade; navegar com fluidez entre contextos técnicos, jurídicos e de negócio. Excelente comunicação e capacidade de simplificar temas complexos para diferentes públicos (Técnicos; Executivos; Áreas de negócio). Perfil com: Alta autonomia; Visão sistêmica; Capacidade de influência; Forte orientação a impacto e resultados. Capacidade de engajar áreas multifuncionais sem relação hierárquica direta. Perfil colaborativo, pragmático e orientado à construção de soluções escaláveis. Seria muito legal se você tivesse (diferencial):   Experiência com: Databricks Unity Catalog, Arquiteturas Lakehouse; Ferramentas de catalogação, qualidade, observabilidade e linhagem de dados. Conhecimento prático em: SQL; Automação de controles; Políticas como código; Data contracts. Experiência com: Integração de logs de auditoria; Soluções de SIEM; Monitoramento de segurança. Certificações em: Governança de Dados; Privacidade; Segurança da Informação. Experiência em: Varejo; E-commerce; Ambientes de alta escala e volumetria de dados. Conhecimento sobre: ANPD; Cenário regulatório brasileiro de proteção de dados. Formação em: Tecnologia; Engenharia; Estatística; Direito Digital; Áreas correlatas. Their culture values humility, creativity, initiative, and excellence.   There is strong room for growth within the company. The person who succeeds in this role will likely have opportunities to expand into leadership and strategy over time.   If this role feels like a fit for you, please apply! They are excited to meet the right person! :)

title: Assistente administrativo industrial
description:

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional organizado(a), analítico(a) e com experiência em gestão de ponto, especialmente em ambiente industrial, para atuar no acompanhamento, tratamento e fechamento da jornada dos colaboradores.      Contratação: pela Umana Brasil, com atuação em um dos nossos clientes.    Local de Atuação: Região do Santa Genebra, Campinas/SP      Principais responsabilidades: ⏰ Gestão do apontamento de jornada • Garantir o registro correto e completo da jornada, incluindo entrada, saída, intervalos, horas extras e ausências.   • Monitorar diariamente inconsistências, como ausências justificadas, faltas não justificadas, divergências de marcação e jornadas incompletas.   • Assegurar a aderência à legislação trabalhista e aos acordos coletivos aplicáveis.   • Observar o correto funcionamento dos relógios de ponto e reportar possíveis problemas ao RH.    Controle do calendário de ponto • Seguir o calendário mensal de fechamento de ponto estabelecido por Folha/AP.   • Reforçar a comunicação dos prazos junto às lideranças operacionais e colaboradores da produção.   • Garantir disciplina no cumprimento de cortes, prévias e fechamentos.   ️ Tratamento de inconsistências • Atuar na regularização de divergências de ponto.   • Validar justificativas, como atestados, abonos, banco de horas e trocas de turno.   • Garantir que os ajustes sejam realizados dentro dos prazos definidos.   • Apoiar na aplicação de medidas disciplinares por irregularidades no apontamento de jornada, sob orientação do RH.   ✅ Fechamento de ponto • Consolidar e validar o fechamento de ponto das áreas sob sua responsabilidade.   • Garantir a integridade e consistência dos dados lançados no sistema de ponto.   • Enviar as informações dentro do prazo e com qualidade.      Requisitos: • Experiência com gestão de ponto em ambiente industrial.   • Noções básicas sobre gestão de pessoas.   • Conhecimento em legislação trabalhista e acordos coletivos.   • Excel em nível intermediário.   • Organização, disciplina e gestão de prazos.   • Capacidade analítica e atenção aos detalhes.   • Boa comunicação e habilidade de influência com liderança operacional.      Presencial - Horário de trabalho:  De segunda a quinta-feira, das 7h às 17h , e às sextas-feiras, das 7h às 16h .    Salário: R$ 2.700,00  Benefícios: ️ Refeitório no local   ️ Vale Alimentação    Vale-transporte pago em cartão    Assistência médica e odontológica sem custo ao titular   ️ Seguro de vida

title: Analista de ehs sr
description:

About the role    Buscamos um(a) Analista de EHS Sr com perfil operacional e dinâmico , que atue diretamente no chão de fábrica, garantindo a execução das rotinas de saúde, segurança e meio ambiente, além de suportar a gestão dos sistemas e indicadores da área.      Key responsibilities Atuação operacional em campo (inspeções, liberações de trabalho, segurança) Suporte na gestão de sistemas de EHS , com foco em normas ISO Acompanhamento de: Gestão de acidentes, Indicadores ambientais (ex: consumo de água e carbono x produção) Controle e gestão de: Destinação de resíduos, Requisitos legais (ex: SOGI) Realização de auditorias internas e suporte a auditorias externas Interação com organismos certificadores (ex: DNV, SGS, BV) Apoio na estruturação de Normas e requisitos do sistema de gestão, Padronização de processos e indicadores Participação em atividades operacionais fora do horário padrão (ex: eventuais sábados para liberações)    Qualifications and skills Profissional hands-on , com forte presença em campo Perfil dinâmico e adaptável , com facilidade para atuar em ambientes de mudança Capacidade de trabalhar com entregas rápidas Olhar crítico e analítico para indicadores e processos Boa organização e senso de prioridade Não terá equipe direta, mas pode interagir com aprendizes e técnicos Experiência com: ISO 14001 (Meio Ambiente), ISO 45001 (Saúde e Segurança) Vivência com auditorias de sistemas de gestão Conhecimento em: Requisitos legais (SOGI ou similares) , Normas regulamentadoras (N R10, NR12) Experiência anterior em ambiente industrial / chão de fábrica Conhecimento em: Excel (indicadores), BI / análise de dados (diferencial) Inglês intermediário (uso eventual, com abertura para desenvolvimento)    About Kerry    Kerry is the world's leading taste and nutrition company for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical industries. Every day we partner with customers to create healthier, tastier and more sustainable products that are consumed by billions of people across the world. Our vision is to be our customers' most valued partner, creating a world of sustainable nutrition. A career with Kerry offers you an opportunity to shape the future of food while providing you opportunities to explore and grow in a truly global environment.

title: Vacation rental revenue manager
description:
Empresa está contratando Vacation rental revenue manager em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

We're hiring a detail-oriented, numbers-driven Vacation Rental Revenue Manager to help Emperor Rentals improve pricing, occupancy, and revenue across our short-term rental portfolio.   This is a fully remote position for candidates currently based in Brazil. You'll work with property performance data, market trends, and pricing tools to help us make smarter revenue decisions every week.   Compensation:   $250 USD per week, paid weekly.   What you'll do:   - Review property performance, pricing, occupancy, ADR, and revenue trends   - Help optimize nightly rates based on seasonality, demand, events, and competitor pricing   - Build and maintain simple revenue reports and forecasts   - Track KPIs and identify opportunities to increase profitability   - Support pricing decisions across Airbnb, short-term rental, and vacation rental channels   - Communicate insights clearly and help the team make data-backed decisions   You may be a great fit if you:   - Are currently based in Brazil and can work remotely   - Are highly analytical, organized, and comfortable working with numbers   - Have strong Excel or Google Sheets skills   - Can spot patterns in data and turn them into practical recommendations   - Are detail-oriented, reliable, and proactive   - Communicate clearly and can work independently   - Are interested in hospitality, Airbnb, short-term rentals, real estate, finance, or revenue management   Nice to have:   - Experience with Airbnb, vacation rentals, hotels, property management, or revenue management   - Experience with pricing tools, market research, dashboards, or financial reporting   - Background in business, finance, economics, analytics, hospitality, or a related field   This role is ideal for someone who enjoys data, pricing strategy, and helping a growing vacation rental company make smarter decisions. If you're based in Brazil and want a remote role where your analysis directly affects business results, we'd love to hear from you.   To apply, please include:   - Your resume   - A short note about your relevant experience   - Your Linked In profile, if available

title: Especialista de consolidação/consolidation specialist - oportunidade também para pcd♿
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Especialista de consolidação/consolidation specialist - oportunidade também para pcd♿ em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION:      The Consolidation Specialist contributes to the production of Imerys' quarterly consolidated financial statements in accordance with IFRS standards, by overseeing the financial statements of the Americas subsidiaries with the Americas Consolidation Manager, and producing Group analyses in coordination with the Group Consolidation team (totalling 9 people), spread across Paris, Brussels, Singapore, and Campinas, covering overall a scope of approximately 220 entities spread across some fifty countries.    The Consolidation Specialist also collaborates closely with the administration team of the SAP FC consolidation software, as well as other departments within Finance (Reporting, Tax, Treasury), both in Brazil and abroad.      KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:      Quarterly package review - Supervise the correct and timely completion of quarterly reporting packages in SAP FC for the Americas scope.   - Analyze balance sheets and variances, equity analyses, tax reviews, and reconciliation of intercompany transactions.   - Ensure the resolution of blocking control and support reporting units with technical queries throughout the closing process.   - Ensure that the consolidated accounts of entities in the region comply with IFRS standards and Group policies.   - Establish, manage, and communicate reporting schedules and closing deadlines for the region.      Group analyses - Contribute to global Group topics, including IFRS 16 (Leases) reviews, mining accounting issues, and other specific key performance indicators.      One-off items - Assist units in preparing for quarterly closings by anticipating the IFRS treatment of specific transactions according to the Group accounting manual.   - Support Mergers & Acquisitions (M& A), divestitures, or internal mergers within the Americas scope.   - Define solutions to improve processes, reporting timelines, and the reliability of consolidated data.      OTHER IMPORTANT FUNCTIONS:    The position includes regular discussions with external auditors regarding the Americas scope and assistance with internal audit requirements. Previous experience in auditing is highly desirable.      REQUIREMENTS:    Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting (Certified Accountant).    Experience: Minimum of 5 to 7 years in accounting, with a strong focus on consolidation and external auditing.    Languages: Fluent English (mandatory for writing and speaking) and advanced Spanish (desirable).      Know-how, skills, abilities and other characteristics:      Technical Skills: Proficiency in Google and Microsoft applications (especially Excel); experience with financial software and databases such as SAP BFC (reporting tool - desirable), SAP 4 HANA (desirable) and Anaplan (desirable).    Soft Skills: Team player, ability to build trust-based relationships with peers and international contacts, and focus on continuous improvement.    Essential Qualities: Organized, strict adherence to deadlines, analytical mindset, autonomy, transparency, and a proactive attitude toward learning.      In commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, this opportunity is also aimed at candidates with disabilities.

This is a highly visible analytical role responsible for ensuring customer churn, revenue impact, retention activity, and related operational metrics are reported accurately, consistently, and with clear business insight. You will partner closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Finance, Rev Ops, and senior leadership to turn churn data into actionable commentary and decisions. The role will strengthen Salesforce and related reporting processes as reliable systems of record, while continuously improving the cadence, quality, and efficiency of churn reporting across the organisation.Key Responsibilities Churn Reporting & Revenue Impact Own reporting of customer churn and associated revenue impact across all business units. Ensure accuracy across multiple methodologies, reconcile results where required, and translate the numbers into a clear story that can be understood and acted on by senior leaders. Retention Analysis & Insight Analyse the customer(churn pipeline and build reporting that delivers insight into retention initiatives, discount usage, save rates, customer contact rates, customer health status, and other leading or lagging indicators of churn risk. Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement Drive standardisation and evolution of churn reporting processes as systems, definitions, and business processes mature. Proactively identify opportunities to improve the reporting cycle, increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the quality of insight month over month. Salesforce Data Quality & Governance Strengthen Salesforce as a system of record by validating data, identifying reporting exceptions, and partnering with Renewals, Rev Ops, Finance, and Revenue Technology stakeholders to ensure dashboards are accurate and items that are not true churn are not reported as churn. Ability to connect churn revenue metrics to retention activity, customer health indicators, and operational performance metrics. Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to double click into results, identify root causes, and explain whether movements are driven by data quality, process, customer behaviour, commercial actions, or broader business trends. Understanding of customer lifecycle, renewals, retention, and churn management processes is highly desirable. Leadership & Stakeholder Management Competent and confident presenting to, influencing, and constructively challenging senior stakeholders. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across multiple stakeholders in a global organisation. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to turn complex data into clear insight, concise commentary, and practical recommendations. Proactive, curious, and comfortable operating in an evolving environment where processes, systems, and definitions continue to mature.

Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

description:

SOC / NOC Technician (L1) — LATAM    Acceleronix | Customer Support / Network Operations | LATAM    Location : Campinas, Brazil      Role Overview    We are expanding our Customer Support function into a 24/7 operation and are looking for a SOC / NOC Technician (L1) to support real-time monitoring, incident detection, ticket management, and escalation across our platform and connectivity environments .    This role is the first operational layer for identifying issues, validating alerts, following playbooks, and escalating incidents to L2 or engineering teams with clear context. The focus is mainly on platform, APIs, connectivity, SIM/network behavior, and service availability . Device-level troubleshooting will be handled by L2.      Key Responsibilities Monitor platform and connectivity environments in real time, including APIs, service availability, device telemetry, SIM status, and network behavior . Identify anomalies, validate alerts, and distinguish false positives from real incidents. Classify incidents by domain: platform, connectivity, or device-related . Follow predefined playbooks for common operational issues. Perform first-level diagnosis to identify whether the issue is related to API/backend, SIM/network/roaming, or device configuration. Create, update, and manage incident tickets in Fresh service or similar tools . Ensure proper ticket categorization, SLA tracking, and timely updates. Escalate incidents to L2, engineering, Customer Support, Solution Architects, or Connectivity/Carrier teams with structured information. Maintain accurate shift logs and support smooth handovers between LATAM, EMEA, and APAC teams. Highlight ongoing incidents, risks, and urgent operational priorities during shift transitions.    Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Computer Science, Information Technology , or a related field. Equivalent practical experience may also be considered. 1–3 years of experience in technical support, NOC/SOC, network operations, or IT operations. Foundational understanding of mobile networks, SIM lifecycle, and connectivity concepts . Basic knowledge of APIs, monitoring tools, and log analysis . Exposure to cloud environments; AWS basics preferred . Ability to follow structured troubleshooting steps and interpret system behavior. Comfortable working rotational shifts and on-call rotations . Native/fluent Portuguese and professional English required . Spanish is a strong plus for LATAM coordination.    Preferred Qualifications Experience with telecom operators, MVNOs, Io T platforms, or connectivity providers. Previous NOC/SOC L1 or L2 experience. Experience with ticketing tools such as Fresh service, Service Now, or Jira Service Management . Certifications such as CCNA, Comp TIA Network+, Security+, JNCIA, AZ-900 , or similar are preferred but not mandatory.    Soft Skills Detail-oriented, structured, and reliable. Calm under pressure. Strong ownership and accountability. Quick learner with strong pattern-recognition ability. Global mindset and collaborative approach. Technician mindset with interest in IT operations, systems, and network reliability.    About Acceleronix    Acceleronix is a global Io T solutions and services enablement provider, part of the Quectel ecosystem, dedicated to accelerating Io T projects for OEMs and enterprises worldwide. We deliver an integrated portfolio that includes an end-to-end Io T platform, edge-device management software, Connectivity-as-a-Service (e SIM, i SIM, v SIM), vertical software, mobile applications, and full-lifecycle cellular and satellite connectivity — empowering customers to build smarter, more efficient solutions while reducing complexity, eliminating risk, and speeding up time-to-market.    With pan-regional R& D teams and expert support across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM, Acceleronix is expanding its footprint in Latin America to serve a rapidly growing base of Io T innovators across smart metering, asset tracking, smart agriculture, connected mobility, and Industry 4.0.      Life at Acceleronix LATAM    At Acceleronix LATAM, no two days are the same. You'll collaborate with a diverse, globally-connected team, engage directly with some of the most innovative OEMs and enterprises in Latin America, and contribute to technologies that are redefining how devices and people connect.   Fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment backed by the resources of a global Io T leader and the Quectel ecosystem Direct access to global R& D, product, and engineering teams across Asia, Europe, and the Americas Regular knowledge-sharing through internal Masterclasses, webinars, and cross-functional project teams A culture of continuous learning — we invest in your growth because your development is our development    Industries & Applications    Acceleronix's Io T solutions power innovation across a wide range of industries. As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact in:   Smart Metering & Utilities — Electricity, water, and gas metering solutions Asset Tracking & Logistics — Fleet management, cold chain, and supply chain visibility Smart Agriculture — Precision farming, greenhouse monitoring, and livestock tracking Smart Cities & Infrastructure — Street lighting, parking, public safety, environmental monitoring Industrial Io T & Automation — Predictive maintenance, factory automation, condition monitoring Connected Mobility & Automotive — Telematics, EV charging, micro-mobility Smart Home & Consumer Io T — Connected appliances, energy management, security    Why Acceleronix LATAM? Global Impact, Regional Focus — Be at the forefront of Io T innovation across Latin America, backed by a global organization with teams in APAC, EMEA, and North America. Career Growth & Development — Access structured mentorship, international exposure, internal mobility, and clear advancement paths within a fast-growing global organization. Cutting-Edge Technology — Work on next-generation Io T platforms, cellular connectivity, e SIM/i SIM, and edge-to-cloud solutions deployed in mission-critical applications. Diversity & Inclusion — Join an inclusive, multicultural workplace where diverse perspectives are valued as key drivers of innovation and success. Global Team & Collaboration — Collaborate with a global network of Io T experts across engineering, sales, marketing, and operations — and with the Quectel ecosystem.    Compensation & Benefits Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks Performance bonus/sales commission structure (role dependent) Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance) Health insurance with no co-pay Life insurance Paid time off International travel opportunities (HQ visits, global trade shows)    Explore Acceleronix — Links & Resources    We encourage all candidates to learn more about Acceleronix before applying. The links below will give you a full picture of who we are, what we build, and what it's like to work here. description:

For our international customer in Valencia, we are looking for a Service Now Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer. The role focuses on ongoing APM data maintenance in Service Now (APM/CMDB-related records as applicable), identifying data gaps and inconsistencies, coordinating updates with application/service owners, and tracking technical debt indicators and remediation progress.EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates need to be based in Valencia or willing to relocate to Valencia. Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required.Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English.Tasks and responsibilities: Perform ongoing maintenance of Application Portfolio Management (APM) data within Service Now, including application inventory, ownership, lifecycle status, technology attributes, and documented integrations/dependencies, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency; Identify and remediate data quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders; Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications; Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging Service Now portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps; Maintain a centralized log or aligned Service Now records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization; Develop and deliver recurring dashboards, reports, and portfolio insights for the onsite Enterprise Architect, including technical debt trends, aging remediation items, progress tracking, and portfolio risk hotspots; Translate stakeholder inputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials; Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices;Profile: Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline; +8 years of overall experience in Information Technology; +3 years of experience supporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams; Hands-on experience with Service Now, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting; Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize); Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights; Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making; Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates; Previous experience delivering similar Service Now APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred; Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail; AI literacy, including practical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks; Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders; Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes; Working knowledge of Service Now data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices; Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including: TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification; Service Now Certified System Administrator (CSA); Service Now Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant Service Now implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB; Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including Service Now EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus; Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage; Fluent in English;

title: Superintendente arquitetura e novas soluções
description:

Criada em 2011, a Zurich Santander Insurance America é uma joint venture entre os grupos Zurich e o Banco Santander, dois dos maiores conglomerados mundiais nos setores de seguros e financeiro. Com uma das maiores carteiras de seguros do mercado, temos sede na Espanha e comercializamos nossos produtos por meio do canal de vendas do Banco Santander no Brasil, México, Chile, Argentina e Uruguai.Na Zurich Santander, trabalhamos todos os dias para que você seja o protagonista de nossa história e tenha o espaço que merece dentro da nossa empresa. Será o guardião da integridade técnica da empresa, liderando arquitetos e engenheiros na construção de ecossistemas robustos, além de atuar como um catalisador de inovação, transformando tendências tecnológicas em vantagens competitivas reais.Quais serão suas principais responsabilidades?- Visão Estratégica: Definir o roadmap tecnológico de longo prazo (Target Architecture), garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos de negócio.- Liderança Técnica: Coordenar e mentorar o time de arquitetos (Sistemas, Dados e Cloud), promovendo as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento e design.- Novas Soluções: Liderar a área de R&D (Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento), avaliando tecnologias emergentes (IA, Web3, Edge Computing, etc.) e conduzindo Provas de Conceito (Po Cs).- Governança e Padrões: Estabelecer padrões arquiteturais, princípios de design e critérios de segurança para garantir a qualidade e a escalabilidade das entregas.- Gestão de Stakeholders: Atuar como ponte entre a tecnologia e o C-Level, traduzindo conceitos técnicos complexos em valor de negócio.- Otimização de Custos: Gerir a eficiência da infraestrutura (Cloud Fin Ops) e o licenciamento de soluções de terceiros.- Tomada de Decisão (Buy vs. Build): Analisar criticamente se as soluções devem ser desenvolvidas internamente ou adquiridas no mercado.Quais são os requisitos que procuramos?- Experiência Sênior: Sólida trajetória em arquitetura de software, infraestrutura em nuvem e liderança de times técnicos de alta performance.- Arquitetura Moderna: Domínio profundo de Microserviços, Event-Driven Architecture (EDA), APIs (REST/Graph QL), Serverless e Cloud Native.- Ambiente Cloud: Experiência avançada em AWS, Azure ou Google Cloud.- Ecossistema de Dados: Conhecimento em arquiteturas de Big Data, Data Lakes e integração de modelos de Machine Learning.- Segurança: Experiência na implementação de conceitos de Security by Design e conformidade (LGPD).- Metodologias: Fluência em Agilidade (Scrum/Kanban) e práticas modernas de Dev Ops/SRE.Para que possa fazer a diferença, é ideal que você tenha as seguintes softskills para esta função:- Pensamento Sistêmico: Capacidade de enxergar o todo e antecipar o impacto de mudanças em grande escala.- Influência e Negociação: Habilidade para convencer stakeholders e alinhar expectativas entre áreas distintas e banco.- Curiosidade Intelectual: Mentalidade de aprendizado contínuo para se manter à frente das tendências globais.- Resiliência: Capacidade de liderar em ambientes de rápida mudança e alta complexidade. Diferenciais:- Experiência em processos de Transformação Digital ou migrações de sistemas legados de larga escala.- Certificações de nível Professional/Specialty em provedores de Cloud.- Participação ativa em comunidades de tecnologia ou contribuição para projetos Open Source.Qual é a nossa Proposta de Valor?Na Zurich Santander lhe propomos fazer parte de uma organização comprometida com o contexto atual, trabalhando profissionalmente na transformação da indústria bancária/seguradora, oferecendo-lhe crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional.Contamos com um excelente ambiente de trabalho, uma equipa de profissionais diversificada e internacional, incentivamos a mobilidade dentro dos países onde estamos presentes para que possa continuar a crescer como profissional. Além disso, dispomos de um pacote de remuneração e benefícios competitivo e atrativo para os nossos colaboradores.Junte-se à nossa equipe!#Juntosprotegemosoquemaisimporta

Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our engineering team builds agentic solutions that data and research teams utilize to transform petabytes of raw data into strategic intelligence. Our resulting product delivers accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers — ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies — depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture — recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years — emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.  What It’s Like to Work at YipitData  YipitData isn’t a place for coasting — it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Ownership That Matters:  You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth:  We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles:  Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose:  We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intention   About The Role  We’re looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/JavaScript/TypeScript, and AWS. That means being responsive, reliable, and an excellent communicator — both when things are going well and especially when they’re not. As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will  Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‑edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Information Technology Manager em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Role Overview  Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration. Key Responsibilities  Business Process Engineering  (Core Expectation) Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes. Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes. Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations. Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.  Automation, Integration & AI Implementation  Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript). Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks. Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.  IT Administration & Security  Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365). Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access. Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security. Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.  Required Qualifications & Skills  Technical Experience:  5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration. Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment. Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures. High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting. Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows. Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.  Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:  Communication:  Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity. Critical Thinking:  Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms. Decision-Making:  Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.  Benefits & Compensation  Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.
