IP Translation and Filing Client Care Specialist  Sun IP is a global leader in patent translation, foreign filing, and annuity solutions, helping intellectual property professionals protect innovation worldwide. We are looking for a motivated, process-focused, IP-knowledgeable Client Care Specialist to join our Filings and Translations department — a collaborative team dedicated to delivering exceptional service to a sophisticated global clientele. Success in this role demands genuine IP knowledge and a meticulous eye for detail. You will be working across a high volume of concurrent matters, each with its own instructions, deadlines, and data requirements — so the ability to prioritize accurately and act before things escalate is essential. You will take a proactive approach to every interaction: anticipating what a client needs, ensuring records are complete and correct, and entering data with the precision that IP demands. This is not a reactive role. It is one where staying ahead of the work, asking the right questions early, and keeping every case moving is what defines a great day. This is a role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment and takes genuine satisfaction in getting the details right. You will manage multiple matters simultaneously across a diverse client base, bringing IP expertise, sharp judgment, and a client-first mindset to everything you do. Main Responsibilities  Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of global IP clients, handling enquiries with professionalism, accuracy, and a proactive approach to resolution. Process patent translation requests in connection with international filings, ensuring all instructions are interpreted correctly and actioned without delay. Manage client correspondence across high-volume shared inboxes, triaging and prioritizing matters according to urgency and deadline sensitivity. Enter and maintain accurate data within our workflow management platform, upholding data integrity at every stage. Follow up with clients on outstanding filing requirements, documentation, and approaching deadlines — anticipating gaps before they become issues. Analyze complex filing instructions and translate them into clear, actionable tasks for internal teams, removing ambiguity and keeping matters on track. Collaborate cross-functionally with Project Management, Accounting, Sales, and other departments to coordinate client deliverables and resolve escalations. Identify and resolve inconsistencies or errors in client instructions, escalating where necessary and always keeping the client informed. Produce and manipulate reports in Microsoft Excel to support internal tracking, client updates, and workflow oversight. Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement by sharing process insights and supporting broader team and company objectives. Manage proactive client contact, ensuring clients are kept informed at every stage of their matters and no update is left outstanding. Act as primary contact for client profile management, maintaining accurate account records, preferences, and filing instructions across all platforms. Lead client onboarding, guiding new clients through Sun IP’s processes, systems, and service offering to ensure a confident and informed start. Deliver virtual training sessions for clients, equipping them with the knowledge to work effectively with our team and tools.  Required Experience  Prior experience in the patent filing industry; experience as a patent filing paralegal is strongly preferred. Demonstrable experience processing patent translation requests in connection with international patent filings. Hands-on experience with docketing systems or similar workflow management platforms. Experience managing client-facing communication around filing requirements, deadlines, and documentation. Strong verbal and written communication skills - you can explain things clearly and confidently, whether in email, one-to-one call, or group meeting.  Skills & Competencies  -IP Knowledge & Process Orientation Solid, working understanding of the patent filing lifecycle, related documentation requirements, and the implications of missed deadlines. Ability to parse and act on complex filing instructions quickly and accurately, translating technical requirements into clear, step-by-step tasks. A process-first mindset: you follow established workflows, flag deviations, and continuously look for ways to improve efficiency without sacrificing quality.  -Client Focus & Communication Genuine commitment to client service — you take ownership of queries, communicate proactively, and never let a matter fall through the cracks. Professional written and verbal communication skills, including polished client-facing email correspondence and confident participation in meetings. Calm and composed under pressure, with the ability to manage urgent, time-sensitive matters without compromising accuracy or client experience.  -Organization & Problem Solving Exceptional attention to detail: you spot errors, inconsistencies, and omissions that others miss, and you act on them decisively. Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with a proven ability to manage a high volume of concurrent matters across varying deadlines. Confident problem-solver who identifies root causes, considers options, and implements solutions - escalating only where genuinely necessary. Ability to manage high-volume shared inboxes effectively, ensuring timely, organized, and consistent responses.  -Technical Proficiency Accurate and efficient data entry. Proficiency across multiple software platforms and case management systems; comfortable onboarding to new tools quickly. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including creating, manipulating, and interpreting reports. Team-oriented and collaborative, with a genuine commitment to supporting colleagues and shared outcomes.

É uma vaga para quem une rigor analítico com visão de processos, e que se interessa genuinamente por automação e pelo uso prático de IA no dia a dia de RH. Se você gosta de trabalhar com dados, entende de remuneração e quer atuar em um ambiente onde tecnologia e pessoas caminham juntas, essa posição é para você! Company Description   Mindhive Global is a New Zealand based, AI-driven technology company, operating at global scale.  Using advanced machine vision and bespoke AI models, the company enables tanneries to grade hides accurately from wet-blue to finished leather and identify defects with greater accuracy and consistency than manual inspection. This verified quality data supports stronger supplier negotiations, improves traceability, and informs strategic decisions. By optimising order fulfillment and quality control, Mindhive Global helps customers increase efficiency, reduce waste, and build more resilient supply chains. The Role  This is not a SaaS helpdesk role!  It is TAM flavoured role, not a pure relationship role.   You will own the day-to-day success of a small portfolio of large, multi-year contracted enterprise accounts  - each operating across multiple sites in multiple countries. You'll work across the full stack: hardware-enabled software deployments in industrial environments, platform adoption, data analysis, executive QBRs, and commercial expansion. You'll be the person who makes Mindhive's verified hide data deliver measurable business value for customers — and who documents and proves that it does. In practice, that means: Owning the full customer relationship  across every stakeholder layer — from site operators on the production floor to executive sponsors in the boardroom — and building multi-threaded coverage so no account is ever dependent on a single contact Driving onboarding and implementation  as the primary customer contact, working alongside Field Operations through installation and onboarding, with a target of time-to-value under six months Analysing operational and customer data  site by site, translating findings into clear insights for both customer and internal audiences — and always validating findings against the customer's operational reality before presenting them Running Quarterly Business Reviews  with executive sponsors, owning the value realisation narrative, and documenting ROI in a form customers can take directly into their own internal reporting Maintaining a five-dimension customer health dashboard  — Relationship, Business Value, Operational Delivery, Adoption, and Commercial Momentum — and flagging risks before they escalate Surfacing expansion opportunities  — additional sites, new product lines, geographic rollouts — and handing them to Commercial with enough context to act Supporting renewal preparation  12–18 months in advance, with a documented value summary and business case  You'll report directly to the Chief Customer Officer (who is based in Auckland New Zealand), and work alongside Commercial, Field Operations, and Product. What this role requires  Fluent English:  written and spoken; all customer and internal work is conducted in English;        (additional languages preferred, especially Portuguese) Demonstrated experience managing more than three  enterprise customers simultaneously , across multiple countries.   If your experience is domestic or single-account, this role is not the right fit Experience with large, strategic accounts on multi-year contracts:  you understand how enterprise relationships are built and protected over time Technical fluency in hardware-enabled software environments: you can engage credibly with IT and operations teams, understand system integrations, and interpret operational data without needing a translator Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% internationally (Brazil, Argentina, UK, Germany, and expanding) Ability to work as a full-time independent contractor, invoicing a New Zealand company  What will make you stand out  Background in sectors where technology is deployed into physical operational environments: manufacturing, food processing, mining, logistics, utilities, or similar Experience with hardware + software deployments (definitely NOT pure SaaS) Data analytics capability: Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or equivalent Active, daily use of AI tools to improve your own output and analysis quality Familiarity with formal customer success frameworks and methodologies  What you'll be measured on  Relationship health, documented ROI delivered for each account, platform adoption rates, onboarding time-to-value, and commercial expansion. You'll own the full customer health picture — not just satisfaction scores. Compensation  Competitive, commensurate with experience. Paid in USD as a contractor engagement.

About Turing:  Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Role Overview:  We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world! What does day-to-day look like:  You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn: Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?) In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.  Requirements:  Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)  Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities. Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours. Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.  Preferred Qualifications:  Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area. Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.) Understanding of Excel and Google Suite. Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.  Perks of Freelancing With Turing:  Work in a fully remote environment. Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies. Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.  Offer Details:  Engagement type :  Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave) Commitments Required :  Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. Nice to Have  –   Experience with SaaS solutions, IoT, smart buildings, analytics, digital platforms, or operational transformation. –   Industry knowledge in retail, airports, hospitality, real estate, or large physical operations. –   Familiarity with CRM tools and Customer Success methodologies (Gainsight, ChurnZero, HubSpot, or similar). WHAT THIS OPPORTUNITY OFFERS  –   A strategic role with direct impact on company growth. –   Work with an innovative SaaS platform in active regional expansion. –   Direct collaboration with Product, Engineering, and Leadership teams. –   Agile, collaborative culture focused on high performance. –   Real space for professional growth and career development across LATAM. description:

Role Overview  We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African/LATAM/Asian currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties. Key Responsibilities  FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS), LATAM (ARS, BRL, MXN) and/or Asian (IDR, VDN, etc.)  on markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks  across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades  to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics  across EM FX markets.  Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategies  to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools  where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization . Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.  Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including: Automated hedging engines  Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers  via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .  Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners  across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs  and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure  supporting global payments and settlement flows.  Requirements  Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience  in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African currencies , such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .  Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets  NDF markets and offshore hedging  Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks  Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems  Hedging engines  Liquidity aggregation platforms  Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .  Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments . Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks . Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.  Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations . Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources . Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies . Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations . Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments  Vision & Mission  OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Médico Gastroenterologista
description:

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO GASTROENTEROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"  Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!  A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Gastroenterologia!  Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando. *SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: * A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas. *O QUE PROCURAMOS: * Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Gastroenterologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos; PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES  Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em gastroenterologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.  Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.  Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.  Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.  Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.  Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais.  Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva.  Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.  Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.  Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.  Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde gastrointestinais.  Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.  Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.  Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.  Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.  Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.  Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.  Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.  REQUISITOS   Formação Acadêmica:   Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA (ou em andamento) OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM GASTROENTEROLOGIA (CLÍNICA OU CIRÚRGICA).  Certificações:   Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Título de Especialista em Gastroenterologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho); ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência médica. Pós ou Especialização na área; Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);  Experiência:   Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em gastroenterologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde; Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico na Atenção Primária à Saúde;  Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:   Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais. Competências Comportamentais:  Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. Outros Requisitos Importantes:   Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável. Local de Trabalho:  REMOTO Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo. IMPORTANTE:  MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO:  Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo. Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.

title: Professor de francês
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Professor de francês em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!   Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!  A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada. Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.  Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.  Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível. *Esta não é uma vaga CLT*  O que oferecemos?  Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos  de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados . Mentorias semanais  com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva  para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.  Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?  Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.  Necessário:  Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais  para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.  O diferencial?  Aqui você é mais que um professor.  Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii  com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.  Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço?  Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as  Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?  Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. About Freight Hero  FreightHero is an AI-native services company built to support the freight brokerage industry, which is in dire need of it. Robin, our autonomous AI agent, handles back-office work end to end. Our Heroes, a sharp human-in-the-loop team, catch the edge cases. Brokers pay us per load, see ROI in weeks, and reassign or eliminate the teams they used to rent. We are backed by incredible investors, including Andrew Ng's AI Fund and supply chain specialists Dynamo Ventures. The thesis is proven. What is next is growth, and that means building a team of incredible people around us to push the company to the next level. The product is real, the customers are real, the revenue is real, and joining now means shaping how this company runs. About the Role  This is a senior full‑stack engineering role focused on building and scaling the core Freight Hero platform. You will work across backend services, integrations, internal tools, and customer-facing features, primarily using Node.js, TypeScript, React, and AWS. You won’t be inheriting a legacy monolith. You’ll be contributing to a modern, event‑driven, AI‑powered system and helping us scale it as customer adoption accelerates. You’ll collaborate closely with product, AI, and customer teams to translate real operational workflows into robust, reliable software. As the team grows, you’ll have opportunities to mentor others, influence architecture, and shape engineering best practices. What Success Looks Like  A successful engineer in this role: Builds scalable, reliable services in Node.js/TypeScript that integrate deeply with customer systems. Designs and maintains AWS‑native infrastructure that is observable, secure, and cost‑efficient. Works cross‑functionally to understand customer workflows and translate them into technical solutions. Ships high‑quality features quickly while maintaining engineering excellence. Identifies opportunities to automate, optimize, and expand the platform. Contributes to a culture of ownership, clarity, and continuous improvement.  Key Responsibilities:  Full Stack Engineering  Build backend services, APIs, and workflow engines using Node.js + TypeScript. Contribute to frontend components when needed using React + VueJS. Implement robust testing, observability, and CI/CD practices.  AWS native Architecture  Design and maintain cloud infrastructure using AWS services such as Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, and more. Ensure systems are scalable, secure, and cost‑optimized.  Systems Integration  Build integrations with TMS platforms, carrier systems, and customer‑specific tools.  Work with internal teams to understand operational processes and translate them into scalable technical solutions. AI Forward Development  Collaborate with AI engineers to embed LLM‑powered workflows into the product. Use AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, and automate repetitive tasks.  Identify opportunities to expand AI‑driven automation across the platform. Collaboration & Impact  Work closely with product, operations, and customer success to deeply understand customer needs. Participate in technical discussions, architectural decisions, and roadmap planning. Help establish engineering best practices as the team grows.  What We Are Looking For  8+ years of professional software engineering experience. Strong expertise in Node.js, TypeScript, React, and AWS cloud architecture. Experience building distributed systems, event‑driven architectures, or workflow automation. Comfortable working across the stack (backend‑heavy, but able to contribute to frontend). Strong communicator who collaborates well with non‑technical teams. High ownership mindset - you thrive in fast‑moving, ambiguous environments. Curiosity about AI and eagerness to leverage it in your day‑to‑day work. Bonus: experience in freight tech, logistics, or integrations with TMS/ERP systems.  Why Freight Hero  Built at the intersection of AI and logistics, one of the most impactful spaces in B2B tech. Work with a team that moves fast, thinks big, and cares deeply about customer outcomes. Opportunities to mentor, influence architecture, and grow as the engineering team scales. Competitive compensation with performance incentives. Fully remote with a collaborative, high‑performance culture.

Ownership That Matters:  You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth:  We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles:  Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose:  We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intention   About The Role  We’re looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will  Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‑edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. description:

Role Overview  We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties. Key Responsibilities  FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS)  or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS)  markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks  across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades  to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics  across EM FX markets.  Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategies  to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools  where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization . Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.  Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including: Automated hedging engines  Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers  via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .  Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners  across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs  and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure  supporting global payments and settlement flows.  Requirements  Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience  in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .  Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets  NDF markets and offshore hedging  Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks  Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems  Hedging engines  Liquidity aggregation platforms  Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .  Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments . Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks . Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.  Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations . Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources . Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies . Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations . Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments  Vision & Mission  OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Regional Study Director, LATAM
description:

Crinetics is a pharmaceutical company headquartered in San Diego, California, with a growing presence in Latin America, including an office in Brazil. We are developing much-needed therapies for people with endocrine diseases and endocrine-related tumors. We were founded by a dedicated team of scientists with the simple belief that better therapies developed from rigorous innovation can lead to better lives. Our work continues to make a real difference in the lives of patients. We have a prolific discovery engine and a robust preclinical and clinical development pipeline. We are driven by science with a patient-centric and team-oriented culture. Crinetics is known for its inclusive workplace culture. This is an exciting time to join Crinetics as we expand our operations in Latin America and shape our organization into the world’s premier fully integrated endocrine company from discovery to patients. Join our team as we transform the lives of others. Position Summary:  Please note, the candidate for this role will need to be located in Brazil.  The Regional Study Director, LATAM is responsible for managing the execution of clinical studies and data collection within the LATAM region. The incumbent will serve as a regional clinical study lead who oversees the review, monitoring, and adherence to clinical protocols, as well as managing and building relationships with clinical sites in LATAM. The Regional Study Director, LATAM may oversee other regional study leads within the region to facilitate a streamlined and quality study execution. This role will also work internally and externally with members of the cross-functional study team. Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities:  These may include but are not limited to: Provide oversight of clinical research studies for LATAM. Manage and build relationships with clinical research sites in LATAM. May oversee the work of other regional study leads within LATAM. Provide operational and strategic input into study documents such as synopsis, protocol, ICF, CRFs, CRF Completion Guidelines, Study Execution Plans, Clinical Data Review Plan, Clinical Database edit specifications, Clinical Study Report (CSR) development, etc. Oversight of all regional vendors and activities including CROs. Oversee regional start up activities including site selection, enrollment projections and activities driving site activation. Develop region specific the subject recruitment/retention strategy and related initiatives. Oversight of regional TMF ongoing quality review, and final reconciliation of study documents including review of site regulatory documents/packages and obtaining of appropriate site insurance, and/or supervision of team members performing these activities. Development of training materials for study team, investigational sites, and vendors. Proactive management of information sharing with key stakeholders using standardized reports and other mechanisms. Assure clinical studies are compliant with GDPR, ICH/GCP and other regulations as appropriate. Outline regional activation hurdles for team. Participate in RFP development and prepare bid templates to facilitate selection of the CROs/vendors, and/or collaboration/supervision with team members performing these activities. Collaborate with counsel to negotiate and draft research contracts and agreements with CROs/vendors and clinical study sites, as needed. Acts as liaison with Regulatory Affairs to assure adherence to GDPR, GCPs; maintenance of SOPs; and assure site and CRO/vendor audits are completed. Perform regional risk management and implement mitigations. Identify potential study issues and recommend and implement solutions or corrective actions as needed. Create realistic plans that clearly define goals, milestones, responsibilities, and results. Maintain focus on strategic objectives while accomplishing operational goals. Make timely, data-driven decisions. Manage daily activities, assign tasks, goals, and development of direct reports. Other duties as assigned.  Required Education and Experience:   Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in scientific discipline. An equivalent combination of relevant education and applicable job experience may be considered. 12 years of prior clinical operations experience preferably with CRO/small biotech experience and approximately 8 years of experience in a supervisory role. Must be able to travel 25-50% of time, may be higher in accordance with project requirements. Computer skills should include proficiency with Microsoft Office suite of software, electronic TMF systems, IXRS and EDC systems. Excellent understanding of drug development process. Experience in clinical trial supply management. Able to make appropriate decisions to move the project(s) forward. Effective verbal and written communication skills. Data flow from sites to data processing, review, and resolution. Analysis and report generation. Knowledge of local regulatory requirements. Ability to handle multiple tasks to meet deadlines in a dynamic environment is essential. Study initiation procedures. Ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action  Travel:   You may be required to travel for up to 25-50% of your time.

Diferenciais desejáveis:  ● Conhecimento em acessibilidade web, HTML semântico e hierarquia de páginas. ● Repertório em análise de funis, proposta de valor e argumentação de conversão. ● Interesse constante por tendências de CRO, UX, Growth e Inteligência Artificial. ● Experiência atuando simultaneamente em múltiplos projetos e clientes. A contratação será para atuação em regime remoto, com possibilidade de deslocamentos pontuais à sede ao longo do ano, conforme necessidade. title: Customer Success Manager
description:

Employment Type:  Full-time position employed by a partner agency (3rd party, B2B) About Sisense  Sisense is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (AnPaaS) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology. With the recent launch of Sisense Intelligence and the Intelligence Assistant, we are accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences that bridge insights to real-time action. The Role  As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts. You will build deep relationships, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, maximize value, and fuel retention and expansion. You will collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication and proactive guidance. Why Join Our Customer Success Team  This is a strategic, high-impact role where you will own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption). You will work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to Sisense’s growth in embedded AI analytics. About You  You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused. You are a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor. You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs. You are proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities. You are collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning.  Requirements  3–5 years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (SaaS/BI/analytics preferred). Strong track record driving product adoption, value realization, NRR, and revenue expansion. Excellent presentation and executive communication skills; experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships. Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio. Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI. Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions. Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps. Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required; Portuguese a plus). Results-driven with critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus. Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment managing multiple priorities. Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/GenAI enablement, or similar technical solutions.  How You’ll Ramp  By Day 30  Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (Sisense values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes). Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value.  By Day 60  Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals). Deepen product/technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work. Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side-by-side with the team.  By Day 90  Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion). Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement. Become a key contributor to the team’s revenue retention and growth goals.  What We Offer  Employment through a partner agency (B2B). Competitive base salary up to USD 3,500 per month (depending on experience). Eligibility for a quarterly performance bonus. Opportunity to work with a global leader in AI-powered embedded analytics. Flexible remote work with a collaborative international team. Professional development and growth opportunities within Customer Success.

title: Médico Nefrologista em Telemedicina (com RQE)
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Médico Nefrologista em Telemedicina (com RQE) em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO NEFROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"  Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!  A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Nefrologia!  Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando. *SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: * A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas. *O QUE PROCURAMOS: * Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Nefrologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos. *PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*  Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Nefrologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.   Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.  Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.  Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas.  Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.  Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.  Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças nefrológicas.  Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.  Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.  Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.   Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Nefrologia.  Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.  Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.  Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.  Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.  Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.   Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.  Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.   REQUISITOS  Formação Acadêmica:  Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM NEFROLOGIA.  Certificações:  Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Título de Especialista em Nefrologia - RQE  (Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado); Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);  Experiência:   Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Nefrologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina. Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:   Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos. Competências Comportamentais:  Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. Outros Requisitos Importantes:   Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável. Local de Trabalho:  REMOTO Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo. IMPORTANTE:  MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO:  Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo. Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.

description:

Ten16 Creative is looking for a mid-level Project Manager based in Brazil to help keep our creative work clear, organized, and moving forward. Ten16 is a creative partner for technology-driven companies, helping teams turn complex products into clear, market-ready brand, campaign, design, web, video, and motion experiences. Our clients operate across areas such as AI, SaaS, gaming, entertainment, consumer electronics, connected hardware, and B2B technology. This is a remote contractor position for someone who is experienced enough to manage multiple moving pieces with confidence, but still hands-on, adaptable, and eager to grow with a fast-moving creative team. The right person will bring structure to creative work without slowing it down. They will help coordinate timelines, deliverables, client communication, internal reviews, production details, and day-to-day follow-through across projects that often involve strategy, design, writing, motion, video, web, and campaign development. About Ten16 CreativeTen16 Creative is a global creative studio with roots in the United States and São Paulo. We help tech-driven companies make complex products easier to understand, trust, and bring to market. Our work spans brand identity, campaign development, design systems, web design, presentations, marketing assets, video, motion, 3D animation, AI-powered production, and creative leadership. We work with companies that need a creative partner who can bring clarity, consistency, and structure to sophisticated products. Our clients have included technology, AI, SaaS, gaming, entertainment, and consumer electronics brands, with representative work across companies and projects in various tech-driven spaces.  About the RoleThe Project Manager will be responsible for helping Ten16 plan, coordinate, and deliver creative projects from kickoff through final delivery. This person will work closely with creative directors, designers, producers, writers, motion teams, developers, and clients to make sure everyone understands what needs to happen, when it needs to happen, and what is required to deliver excellent work. This role is ideal for someone who has already worked in an agency, creative studio, production company, marketing team, or digital product environment and understands how creative work moves from brief to execution. The role does not require senior-level account leadership, but it does require organization, fluent English and Portuguese communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.  You will manage active project timelines and ensure that milestones, deliverables, meetings, and reviews are clearly documented and communicated. You will help turn creative scopes into practical schedules, making sure that internal team members understand priorities and that clients understand what is needed from them to keep projects moving. You will coordinate daily and weekly project activity across brand, design, web, video, motion, campaign, and presentation work. This includes assigning or tracking tasks, following up on open items, preparing meeting agendas, documenting decisions, and making sure feedback is captured accurately. You will also help maintain project management tools, shared folders, project boards, calendars, and production documents so the team always has a reliable source of truth. You will support client-facing communication in English with professionalism and clarity. This may include sending status updates, recapping meetings, organizing feedback, preparing for presentations, and helping the team stay ahead of deadlines. Because Ten16 works with technology-driven companies, you should be comfortable working on projects where the subject matter may be complex, technical, or still evolving. You will help protect the quality of the work by making sure deliverables are complete, organized, properly labeled, and ready for review or delivery. You will not be expected to creative-direct the work, but you should have a strong eye for detail and enough creative production experience to recognize when something is missing, unclear, or not ready to send. QualificationsThe ideal candidate has approximately 3–5 years of experience in project management, creative production, account coordination, marketing operations, agency operations, or a related role. They should have experience managing creative deliverables and coordinating cross-functional teams in a remote environment. They must be located in Brazil and must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. English fluency is essential because the role will involve written and spoken communication with U.S.-based team members and clients. Portuguese fluency is equally important for collaboration with Brazil-based team members and vendors.

Proactively identify opportunities to improve the reporting cycle, increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the quality of insight month over month. Leadership & Stakeholder Management  Competent and confident presenting to, influencing, and constructively challenging senior stakeholders. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across multiple stakeholders in a global organisation. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to turn complex data into clear insight, concise commentary, and practical recommendations. Proactive, curious, and comfortable operating in an evolving environment where processes, systems, and definitions continue to mature.   Why This Role Matters  Customer health and recurring revenue are central to a growth business. This role ensures the organisation has accurate, consistent, and insightful visibility of churn and retention performance, helping leaders identify early warning signals, understand the impact of retention initiatives, and take action to protect material revenue. As the company scales, the Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn will play a key role in strengthening the reporting foundation, improving Salesforce data quality, and enabling better decisions that support customer satisfaction, renewal outcomes, and sustainable growth.

description:

Make this the place where you grow!  Na NTT DATA Business Solutions, impulsionamos a inovação – desde consultoria e implementação até serviços gerenciados e além, impulsionados por uma equipe global e mais de 18.500 especialistas representando mais de 90 nações em mais de 30 países. Fazemos parte da NTTDATA, líder de US$ 30+ bilhões em serviços empresariais e tecnológicos, IA e infraestrutura digital, atendendo 75% da Fortune Global 100. Co-inovamos soluções com clientes e parceiros globalmente para impacto empresarial e social. Como um dos principais empregadores globais, a NTT DA-TA conta com especialistas em mais de 70 países. A NTT DA-TA faz parte do Grupo NTT. Conosco, você tem infinitas oportunidades para pensar grande, agir com ousadia e assumir a responsabilidade. Faça deste o lugar onde você pertence, aprende e constrói sua rede. Make this the place where you grow!  Estamos buscando Líder AMS  para atuar em Managed Services, liderando sustentação e evolução de SAP SD , com foco em organização de fila, governança e comunicação com o cliente. Se você tem perfil dinâmico, gosta de coordenar demandas e garantir uma experiência sólida em AMS, essa oportunidade é para você! A vaga também é ideal para consultores(as) SAP SD que desejam dar o próximo passo na carreira e migrar para um papel de liderança , ampliando sua atuação para gestão de equipe, priorização e relacionamento com clientes. Organizar o time de AMS, controlando e priorizando as atividades em andamento. Aplicar e garantir a governança dos processos de atendimento de tickets, conforme regras e fluxos definidos pelo cliente. Elaborar relatórios e indicadores de atendimento, apresentando mensalmente os resultados e status da operação. Atuar como ponto focal do cliente para temas relacionados à sustentação SAP SD.  Requisitos:  Superior Completo. Conhecimento funcional em SAP SD no mínimo Sênior aplicado a ambientes produtivos. Sólida experiência como Consultor SAP SD, com interesse em migrar para a área de liderança. Vivência em ambientes de sustentação/AMS, com foco em atendimento de tickets.
