title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Empresa está contratando Customer Success Manager em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

WHO ARE WE?  We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy! CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention. Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including: CloudSEK’s Product Suite:  CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support. A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets. CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies. Key Milestones:  2016: Launched our first product. 2018: Secured Pre-series A funding. 2019: Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas. 2020: Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year. 2021: Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures. Awards & Recognition: Won NetApp Excellerator's \"Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award. 2025: Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.  Job Description:  As a Customer Success Manager at CloudSEK , you will be the primary point of contact for a few strategic accounts, ensuring they derive maximum value from our cybersecurity solutions . Your role will involve deep engagement with clients , providing expert guidance on threat management, and ensuring seamless integration and utilization of CloudSEK’s products . Your background in cybersecurity will be crucial in understanding and addressing the specific needs and challenges faced by our clients. Key Responsibilities:  Account Management:  Manage and nurture relationships for a client accounts, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and retention. Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Annual Business Reviews (ABRs) to assess and enhance customer engagement. Visit customers twice a year to strengthen relationships and understand their evolving needs.  Cybersecurity Expertise:  Provide expert guidance on threat intelligence, data leak prevention, and other cybersecurity issues. Act as a security analyst, offering insights and recommendations based on threats generated by CloudSEK’s platform. Collaborate with customer security teams to ensure optimal usage of CloudSEK’s solutions.  Customer Engagement:  Develop and execute customer engagement strategies to build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including CXOs and CISOs. Foster customer champions within client organizations to drive advocacy and referrals. Generate and share client-specific quality reports, gathering feedback to continuously improve service delivery.  Revenue Generation and Retention:  Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling CloudSEK’s products and services. Ensure on-time renewals and maintain a high customer retention rate. Source referrals and participate in revenue generation activities.  Product Usage and Feedback:  Ensure 100% product usage for features subscribed by the customers. Conduct configuration reviews and provide recommendations for product enhancements. Gather and analyze customer feedback to contribute to product development and improvement.  Operational Excellence:  Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and activities in CRM systems. Contribute to the team by sharing knowledge, conducting training sessions, and writing internal articles.  Ideal candidate:   4-5 years of experience in Cybersecurity & Client-facing experience, or a related role in the cybersecurity industry.  Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, threat intelligence, and digital risk management.  Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with clients. Strong language proficiency over English and Portuguese is required.  Proven track record of achieving customer success goals and driving revenue growth.  Ability to work independently and manage multiple accounts  simultaneously.  Cookie points if you have experience in the below skills:  Business reviews: Onsite meetings Maintaining NRR and GRR Threat analysis and Value delivery  Benefits of Joining CloudSEK:   We provide an environment where you can develop and enhance your skills while delivering meaningful work that matters. You’ll be rewarded a competitive salary as well as a full spectrum of generous perks and incentives which include: Flexible working hours. Food, unlimited snacks and drinks are all available while at office. And, the finest part is yet to come! Every now and then we ensure to unwind and have a good time together, which involves games, fun, and soulful music. Feel free to show off your artistic side here! CloudSEK is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior (Plataforma de RH e DP)
description:
Empresa está contratando Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior (Plataforma de RH e DP) em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior  para ser um pilar técnico no desenvolvimento e evolução dos nossos produtos corporativos, com foco principal na criação da nossa nova plataforma interna de Recursos Humanos e Departamento Pessoal. Em um ambiente dinâmico de uma empresa de gestão de saúde, sua missão é atuar de ponta a ponta na construção de soluções de alto impacto. Você liderará tecnicamente o desenvolvimento de um ecossistema completo que gerenciará a jornada dos nossos colaboradores, desde a admissão virtual e gestão de ponto eletrônico, até o processamento complexo da folha de pagamento. Além de escrever código escalável e de alta qualidade utilizando o ecossistema Node.js e React, você deverá liderar pelo exemplo, mentorar outros desenvolvedores e ditar os padrões de arquitetura da equipe. Principais Responsabilidades  Arquitetura e Desenvolvimento: Projetar e desenvolver aplicações full stack de alta complexidade, implementando padrões de arquitetura definidos e garantindo a consistência do código. Desenvolvimento de Módulos Core (RH/DP): Criar fluxos de Admissão automatizados e seguros. Construir e manter o motor de cálculo da Folha de Pagamento e Rescisões, garantindo precisão absoluta. Desenvolver a gestão de Férias e o processamento de marcações de Ponto Eletrônico. Legislação e Integrações: Traduzir regras da CLT e acordos sindicais em lógicas de sistema. Criar integrações robustas com sistemas bancários, APIs contábeis e órgãos governamentais (ex: e-Social), além de atuar no design de APIs (REST). Liderança e Mentoria: Mentorar desenvolvedores(as) de nível pleno e júnior, realizando code reviews construtivos e disseminando boas práticas de mercado. Automação e Qualidade: Garantir a qualidade através da implementação de uma estratégia sólida de testes automatizados (unitários, integração, e2e) e utilizar ativamente ferramentas de IA para geração de código, visando produtividade. Infraestrutura e Deploy: Trabalhar com Docker para manter ambientes consistentes e atuar ativamente em esteiras de CI/CD para entregas contínuas.  Formação e Experiência  Experiência Específica em RH: Experiência comprovada na construção de sistemas de Recursos Humanos (HCM/HRMS), Departamento Pessoal, Workforce Management (ponto/escalas) ou plataformas de processamento financeiro complexo. Experiência Técnica: Sólida vivência em desenvolvimento full stack corporativo, atuando de ponta a ponta na concepção de produtos. Metodologias: Sólida vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) em times de produto, além de entendimento claro de workflows como GitFlow. Formação: Ensino Superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou experiência prática equivalente.  Habilidades Técnicas (Hard Skills)  Stack Principal: Domínio avançado do ecossistema Node.js (NestJS, Express) e React (incluindo Next.js). Familiaridade com TypeScript e Vue.js. Bancos de Dados: Proficiência em bancos relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL), ORMs, modelagem de tabelas e entendimento profundo de DER, além de transações consistentes. DevOps & Cloud: Excelente conhecimento em Docker e ambiente Linux. Vivência prática com provedores Cloud (GCP, Azure) e cultura DevOps (CI/CD). Ferramentas: Proficiência com Git/GitHub e experiência no uso de ferramentas de IA assistiva (como Claude Code ou similares).  Habilidades Comportamentais (Soft Skills)  Autonomia e Pragmatismo: Capacidade de resolver problemas complexos com autonomia, propondo melhorias técnicas e transitando entre tecnologias de forma pragmática, focando na melhor solução para o contexto. Foco no Usuário e Qualidade: Entender a criticidade financeira e humana de um sistema de DP/RH, responsabilizando-se pelo funcionamento impecável das regras de negócio. Tradução de Requisitos: Facilidade para dialogar com especialistas de DP/RH para transformar leis e portarias em lógica matemática de software. Gestão de Crise: Perfil analítico para lidar com gargalos ou bugs de forma ágil e fria, especialmente em momentos críticos (fechamento de folha).  Diferenciais  Experiência com React Native para desenvolvimento mobile. Conhecimentos avançados em performance de aplicações e otimização de queries de banco de dados. Conhecimento prévio em PHP e/ou Python para auxiliar na manutenção ou migração de sistemas legados. Ter atuado em HRTechs ou possuir forte interesse no desenvolvimento de produtos para a área da saúde.  Contrato PJ  100% Remoto    E aí, topa o desafio? Estamos ansiosos para ter você conosco! ☺

title: Head of Liquidity LATAM
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Head of Liquidity LATAM em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company  We are a leading digital asset platform that provides trading, brokerage, custody, and infrastructure solutions for institutional and professional investors. As the business continues to grow, they are seeking an experienced liquidity professional to lead and enhance their global liquidity capabilities. Role Overview  This leadership role is responsible for overseeing liquidity strategy across digital asset and FX markets in LATAM, ensuring efficient market access, strong execution quality, and robust liquidity coverage across trading products. The successful candidate will work closely with Trading, Sales, Product, Risk, Compliance, Treasury, and Technology teams to support the firm's institutional trading business. We cover stablecoins, on/off ramp and cross-border payments as well. Candidates with relevant experiences will be prioritized. Key Responsibilities  Liquidity Management  Develop and execute the firm's liquidity strategy across digital asset and FX-related markets. Source, onboard, and manage relationships with liquidity providers, market makers, brokers, exchanges, and banking partners. Monitor liquidity quality, market depth, pricing competitiveness, and venue performance. Ensure sufficient liquidity coverage across supported products and trading activities.  FX & Trading Operations  Oversee liquidity and execution across FX and digital asset trading flows. Monitor market developments and identify opportunities to improve execution performance and pricing. Analyze trading activity, transaction costs, spreads, and execution metrics. Partner with trading and treasury teams to optimize execution workflows and market access.  Counterparty & Vendor Management  Build and maintain relationships with key liquidity providers and institutional counterparties. Support commercial negotiations, fee discussions, and service-level reviews. Conduct ongoing assessments and due diligence of trading venues and liquidity partners.  Risk & Governance  Work closely with Risk and Compliance teams to ensure appropriate controls and oversight. Monitor counterparty, settlement, and liquidity-related risks. Support contingency planning and business continuity measures during periods of market stress.  Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement  Lead and develop the liquidity function. Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Trading, Treasury, Product, Technology, Risk, and Compliance teams. Provide management reporting on liquidity performance, market developments, and strategic initiatives.  Requirements  Significant experience in liquidity management, electronic trading, FX trading, market structure, market making, brokerage, or institutional trading environments. Experience sourcing, evaluating, and managing relationships with liquidity providers, brokers, market makers, exchanges, and banking partners. Strong understanding of FX and/or digital asset liquidity ecosystems and execution practices. Ability to analyze execution quality, transaction costs, and liquidity performance metrics. Commercially minded with strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills. Experience working within regulated financial services environments. Excellent communication, leadership, and relationship management capabilities.

title: People Specialist - Payroll
description:
Empresa está contratando People Specialist - Payroll em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

About Revolut  People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day. As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution. About the role  Revolut’s People team shapes how we support our people and ensure a seamless experience every day. From onboarding to coaching and development, they partner with teams across the business to create a people-first environment that enables growth and success. We're looking for a Payroll Specialist to provide the greatest support to our employees by delivering everyday payroll tasks globally and keeping the employment life cycle running smoothly. You'll manage salaries, answer employee queries, and collaborate with third-party vendors, as well as contribute to building the infrastructure enabling Revolut's continuous growth. Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch. What you'll be doing  Managing accurate and compliant employment-related payments and deductions for assigned countries Providing the highest level of service by advising employees on payroll-related questions, ensuring deadlines and SLAs Ensuring accurate and timely data collection and validation Liaising with key stakeholders, such as HR, payroll providers, and Finance Forecasting salaries and bank transfers Overseeing proper statutory and internal reporting Participating in payroll audits Streamlining and documenting internal processes and policies Enhancing and establishing efficient controls to reduce risk of failing Spearheading compensation and benefits initiatives in close collaboration with the HR Advisory team  What you'll need  4+ years of experience as a Payroll Administrator, Payroll Specialist, or Payroll Analyst managing end-to-end cycles In-depth knowledge of local income tax, social security, pension, statutory leaves, and other payroll elements Hands-on experience with payroll and HR software Experience managing payroll integrations and complex systems Experience in vendor management and working with external partners  Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working te am.Important notice for candidat  es:Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open rol es.• Only apply through official Revolut channe ls. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitme nt.• Always double-check the emails you recei ve. On the AI side:  Their ideal candidate actively uses tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini as part of a daily workflow. They understand prompting for content, imagery, coding, research, and strategy. They see AI as a multiplier for creativity and execution rather than a replacement for skill. Agency experience is strongly preferred, especially for someone familiar with fast turnarounds, proactive communication, and problem-solving before issues escalate. title: Business Information Security Officer
description:
Empresa está contratando Business Information Security Officer em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud. The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves. Job Title: Business Information Security Officer (BISO / BSO) Role Summary The Business Information Security Officer (BISO/BSO) serves as the primary security liaison between the business, enterprise security, and GRC functions. The role ensures that information security risks are appropriately identified, assessed by accountable teams (e.g., GRC, vendor risk, compliance), clearly communicated to business stakeholders, and effectively acted upon. The BISO enables secure-by-design execution across business initiatives while ensuring alignment with enterprise security frameworks and regulatory requirements such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, and FedRAMP. Key Responsibilities 1. Secure-by-Design Advisory & Consulting Act as a trusted security advisor to business and delivery teams, embedding security-by-design principles into initiatives from early design stages. Translate enterprise security standards and regulatory requirements (ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, FedRAMP) into actionable guidance and security user stories. Collaborate with architecture, engineering, and security teams to ensure security requirements are understood and incorporated into solution design. 2. SDLC Security Enablement (Coordination Role) Ensure security requirements are integrated into SDLC processes for in-scope applications. Coordinate with GRC, application security, and engineering teams to ensure security assessments, control validation, and remediation activities are executed. Track security findings and ensure remediation plans are clearly understood and actioned by delivery teams. 3. Third-Party Risk & Due Diligence Coordination Act as the business-facing liaison for third-party risk management activities conducted by GRC and vendor risk teams. Ensure due diligence requests are completed by relevant stakeholders and that outcomes are communicated in business terms. Facilitate business understanding of vendor risk posture and support informed risk decisions. 4. Divestiture / Transformation Support (Orthopedic Programs) Support security activities for orthopedic divestiture and transformation initiatives. Coordinate across IT, GRC, security, and business teams to ensure security requirements are addressed during transition planning and execution. Ensure alignment with enterprise security frameworks and regulatory obligations throughout the transformation lifecycle. 5. Physical Site Security Coordination Support physical security assessments for scoped orthopedic sites conducted by appropriate security teams. Ensure findings, gaps, and remediation actions are clearly communicated to business and site leadership. Track remediation progress and support closure of identified risks. 6. Risk Governance, Communication & Collaboration Facilitate security risk acknowledgement and decision-making discussions between GRC and business stakeholders. Ensure risks, control gaps, and mitigation plans are clearly understood and appropriately documented. Enable risk acceptance processes by ensuring business stakeholders are informed and aligned. Collaborate across multiple teams (GRC, IT, engineering, legal, compliance, and business units) to ensure coordinated security outcomes. Key Deliverables Security-by-design guidance aligned to ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, and FedRAMP frameworks Coordinated tracking of SDLC security activities and remediation status Third-party risk communication summaries (from GRC outputs) Divestiture security coordination artifacts and transition support documentation Physical site assessment coordination reports and action tracking Risk acknowledgement and acceptance documentation Executive-level security status reporting for business stakeholders Core Competencies Strong understanding of enterprise security frameworks: ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, FedRAMP Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills Ability to translate technical risk into business impact and decision-ready language Strong coordination Equality & Opportunity for All  Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws   At HCLTech, we don’t just offer jobs — we offer journeys. Join a global team where your work drives innovation, your ideas matter, and your growth is supported every step of the way.   Why Choose HCLTech?  Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint Collaborate with diverse teams across borders Work on cutting-edge technologies in enterprise integration Enjoy career mobility, continuous learning, and a culture of inclusion

title: Especialista em Governança de Dados
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Especialista em Governança de Dados em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Somos o Grupo Casas Bahia, com mais de 70 anos de história, realizando os sonhos de +100 milhões de brasileiros. Aqui, somos protagonistas o tempo todo, sempre com integridade e ética em tudo o que fazemos. A paixão pela nossa gente é o que nos move, e a dedicação total ao cliente é o nosso compromisso diário. Entregamos resultados e buscamos sempre a simplicidade em tudo o que fazemos! Buscamos um(a) Especialista em Governança de Dados para estruturar, evoluir e operacionalizar o framework de governança da nossa Plataforma de Dados. Este papel é fundamental para garantir que os dados da companhia sejam confiáveis, descobríveis, seguros e em conformidade — transformando governança de um requisito de compliance em um habilitador de valor para o negócio. Mais do que definir políticas e padrões, este papel exige profundidade técnica em plataformas modernas de dados, visão sistêmica do ciclo de vida do dado e capacidade de implementar governança de forma prática e escalável, embarcada na esteira de desenvolvimento. O objetivo é elevar a maturidade de governança da companhia, tornando-a um diferencial competitivo sustentado por automação e cultura. Responsabilidades  Atuar diretamente na definição, evolução e operacionalização do framework corporativo de Governança de Dados da plataforma. Definir, manter e disseminar políticas, padrões e processos relacionados à governança de dados, incluindo: Catalogação, Classificação, Qualidade de dados, Linhagem, Ciclo de vida do dado; Gestão de acessos. Estruturar e evoluir o catálogo corporativo de dados, garantindo descoberta, documentação, rastreabilidade e contexto de negócio para os ativos de dados. Implementar e governar controles de qualidade de dados, incluindo: Definição de regras; Monitoramento contínuo; Alertas e Processos de remediação. Liderar iniciativas de classificação e proteção de dados sensíveis e pessoais, assegurando conformidade com LGPD e demais regulamentações aplicáveis. Atuar com visão ponta a ponta do ecossistema de dados, compreendendo: Fluxos de dados em arquiteturas modernas (Bronze → Silver → Gold); Linhagem e gestão ativa de metadados; Controles de acesso e segregação de dados; Técnicas de mascaramento, anonimização e proteção de dados. Definir e operacionalizar papéis e responsabilidades de governança: Data Owners; Data Stewards e Custodiantes. Integrar práticas de governança à esteira de desenvolvimento de dados, automatizando controles e reduzindo fricção para os times de engenharia. Atuar em parceria com Segurança da Informação, Privacidade, Jurídico e Compliance em temas relacionados a auditoria, conformidade e resposta a incidentes. Apoiar demandas regulatórias, auditorias e requisições relacionadas a titulares de dados. Definir, acompanhar e comunicar métricas e indicadores de: Maturidade de governança; Qualidade de dados. Promover cultura orientada a dados e disseminar boas práticas de governança na organização, atuando como referência técnica no tema.  Requisitos e Qualificações  Experiência consolidada em Governança de Dados, preferencialmente em: Ambientes de alta complexidade técnica; Contextos com múltiplos stakeholders; Plataformas analíticas, Data Lake, Data Warehouse ou arquiteturas Lakehouse. Conhecimento sólido e aplicado em: Catalogação, classificação e gestão de metadados; Qualidade, linhagem e ciclo de vida de dados; Gestão de acessos e proteção de dados sensíveis; LGPD e frameworks de governança e privacidade, como DAMA-DMBOK, ISO 27001 e SOC 2. Experiência atuando em conjunto com: Engenharia de Dados; Analytics; Segurança da Informação; Privacidade. Capacidade de implementar governança de forma prática; automatizada; integrada aos processos. Forte habilidade para: traduzir requisitos regulatórios em controles técnicos aplicáveis; definir métricas e acompanhar evolução de maturidade; navegar com fluidez entre contextos técnicos, jurídicos e de negócio. Excelente comunicação e capacidade de simplificar temas complexos para diferentes públicos (Técnicos; Executivos; Áreas de negócio). Perfil com: Alta autonomia; Visão sistêmica; Capacidade de influência; Forte orientação a impacto e resultados. Capacidade de engajar áreas multifuncionais sem relação hierárquica direta. Perfil colaborativo, pragmático e orientado à construção de soluções escaláveis.  Seria muito legal se você tivesse (diferencial):  Experiência com: Databricks Unity Catalog, Arquiteturas Lakehouse; Ferramentas de catalogação, qualidade, observabilidade e linhagem de dados. Conhecimento prático em: SQL; Automação de controles; Políticas como código; Data contracts. Experiência com: Integração de logs de auditoria; Soluções de SIEM; Monitoramento de segurança. Certificações em: Governança de Dados; Privacidade; Segurança da Informação. Experiência em: Varejo; E-commerce; Ambientes de alta escala e volumetria de dados. Conhecimento sobre: ANPD; Cenário regulatório brasileiro de proteção de dados. Formação em: Tecnologia; Engenharia; Estatística; Direito Digital; Áreas correlatas.  Confira alguns dos benefícios incríveis que preparamos para garantir seu bem-estar e qualidade de vida:  PLR/Bônus : Um reconhecimento extra para valorizar o seu esforço e dedicação!   Assistência Médica e Odontológica : Para que você tenha toda a segurança e cuidado com a sua saúde e a da sua família.   Vale Refeição : Porque sabemos que uma alimentação de qualidade é essencial para o seu dia a dia!  ️ Seguro de Vida : Tranquilidade e proteção para você e seus entes queridos.

Overview  Full Spectrum Search Group is a national healthcare recruiting firm focused on post-acute and senior care leadership, including skilled nursing, senior living, home health, and hospice. We are hiring a Recruiter to execute on active searches and drive candidate engagement across our client portfolio. This role is responsible for identifying, engaging, and advancing top talent through the interview process. This is a phone-first, outbound recruiting role. Success in this position is driven by the ability to engage passive candidates  and turn initial outreach into meaningful conversations. If you are competitive, relationship-driven, and motivated by results, this role is for you. About the Role  This role sits at the core of our recruiting execution. You will partner with leadership and work closely with the operations and research team to identify and engage candidates for active searches. This is a production-driven role. Your success is measured by activity, candidate quality, and your ability to move candidates through the hiring process. There is a steep but rewarding learning curve. You will be expected to quickly learn both our recruiting process and the nuances of the post-acute healthcare industry, including terminology, roles, and market dynamics. Professional development is a core part of this role. The individuals who succeed here are those who actively invest in learning, improving, and refining their craft. Candidate Sourcing and Outreach  Proactively identify and engage passive candidates  through outbound calling, LinkedIn, CRM databases, referrals, and targeted call sheets Prioritize phone-based outreach  as the primary method of engagement, including calling candidates at their place of work when appropriate Utilize call lists and target data provided by the research team to execute structured outreach campaigns Supplement outreach with LinkedIn messaging, email, and text to increase response rates Manage and respond to inbound candidates (Indeed, LinkedIn, referrals), while maintaining a primary focus on outbound recruiting  Candidate Qualification and Assessment  Conduct high-quality screening calls with both outbound (passive) and inbound candidates Ask targeted, thoughtful questions to uncover experience, motivations, and openness to new opportunities Present opportunities in a clear, compelling way that resonates with passive candidates Accurately document candidate details including compensation expectations, timing, and potential barriers  Pipeline Management and Execution  Build and maintain a pipeline primarily driven by passive candidate outreach , not just inbound applicants Manage multiple active searches simultaneously while maintaining organization and momentum Ensure candidates are consistently moving through the process without delays Prepare candidates for client interviews, including expectations, positioning, and feedback Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in Crelate and related systems  Client and Team Collaboration  Partner with leadership to align on candidate profiles and search priorities Communicate candidate updates, challenges, and market feedback in a timely manner Work closely with the operations and research team to ensure strong execution across all searches Contribute to team discussions around search strategy, candidate quality, and market trends  Performance Expectations  Maintain consistent daily call volume  with a strong emphasis on outbound phone activity Demonstrate the ability to engage and convert passive candidates into active conversations  Build a steady pipeline of qualified candidates sourced through outbound efforts Deliver a consistent number of qualified candidate presentations per week Maintain strong follow-up and response times with candidates and internal team members  What You’ll Bring  Strong verbal and written communication skills suitable for professional U.S. business communication Understanding of American business culture, communication style, and professional expectations Comfort with high-volume outreach and phone-based recruiting Ability to build rapport quickly and maintain relationships with candidates Strong organization and time management skills Competitive, driven mindset with a desire to be successful Positive attitude and ability to keep pace with a fast-moving, high-performing team Strong technical proficiency and comfort learning new tools and systems Professional home office setup suitable for business calls Reliable high-speed internet and availability during U.S. business hours (Central Time)  What Separates Top Recruiters  You are comfortable calling candidates who are not actively looking and earning their interest You default to picking up the phone instead of relying solely on messages or applications You know how to turn a cold call into a meaningful career conversation You actively invest time in learning the industry, terminology, and roles you recruit for You generate your own pipeline rather than relying on inbound flow You maintain persistence and follow-through without being transactional  Ideal Background  Experience in recruiting, sales, or other high-activity, performance-driven roles Experience with outbound calling, business development, or candidate sourcing Familiarity with healthcare or executive recruiting is a plus, but not required Track record of meeting or exceeding performance expectations  Compensation and Logistics  Competitive monthly salary plus performance-based commission Full-time remote position Central Time schedule Performance-based growth opportunities

Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade  (ex: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK). Familiaridade com arquitetura orientada a domínios (DDD)  e Data Mesh . Conhecimento em CI/CD  e integração com pipelines de dados. Experiência com ambientes cloud-native  e containers (Docker, Kubernetes) . description:

Company Description   Mindhive Global is a New Zealand based, AI-driven technology company, operating at global scale.  Using advanced machine vision and bespoke AI models, the company enables tanneries to grade hides accurately from wet-blue to finished leather and identify defects with greater accuracy and consistency than manual inspection. This verified quality data supports stronger supplier negotiations, improves traceability, and informs strategic decisions. By optimising order fulfillment and quality control, Mindhive Global helps customers increase efficiency, reduce waste, and build more resilient supply chains. The Role  This is not a SaaS helpdesk role!  It is TAM flavoured role, not a pure relationship role.   You will own the day-to-day success of a small portfolio of large, multi-year contracted enterprise accounts  - each operating across multiple sites in multiple countries. You'll work across the full stack: hardware-enabled software deployments in industrial environments, platform adoption, data analysis, executive QBRs, and commercial expansion. You'll be the person who makes Mindhive's verified hide data deliver measurable business value for customers — and who documents and proves that it does. In practice, that means: Owning the full customer relationship  across every stakeholder layer — from site operators on the production floor to executive sponsors in the boardroom — and building multi-threaded coverage so no account is ever dependent on a single contact Driving onboarding and implementation  as the primary customer contact, working alongside Field Operations through installation and onboarding, with a target of time-to-value under six months Analysing operational and customer data  site by site, translating findings into clear insights for both customer and internal audiences — and always validating findings against the customer's operational reality before presenting them Running Quarterly Business Reviews  with executive sponsors, owning the value realisation narrative, and documenting ROI in a form customers can take directly into their own internal reporting Maintaining a five-dimension customer health dashboard  — Relationship, Business Value, Operational Delivery, Adoption, and Commercial Momentum — and flagging risks before they escalate Surfacing expansion opportunities  — additional sites, new product lines, geographic rollouts — and handing them to Commercial with enough context to act Supporting renewal preparation  12–18 months in advance, with a documented value summary and business case  You'll report directly to the Chief Customer Officer (who is based in Auckland New Zealand), and work alongside Commercial, Field Operations, and Product. What this role requires  Fluent English:  written and spoken; all customer and internal work is conducted in English;        (additional languages preferred, especially Portuguese) Demonstrated experience managing more than three  enterprise customers simultaneously , across multiple countries.   If your experience is domestic or single-account, this role is not the right fit Experience with large, strategic accounts on multi-year contracts:  you understand how enterprise relationships are built and protected over time Technical fluency in hardware-enabled software environments: you can engage credibly with IT and operations teams, understand system integrations, and interpret operational data without needing a translator Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% internationally (Brazil, Argentina, UK, Germany, and expanding) Ability to work as a full-time independent contractor, invoicing a New Zealand company  What will make you stand out  Background in sectors where technology is deployed into physical operational environments: manufacturing, food processing, mining, logistics, utilities, or similar Experience with hardware + software deployments (definitely NOT pure SaaS) Data analytics capability: Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or equivalent Active, daily use of AI tools to improve your own output and analysis quality Familiarity with formal customer success frameworks and methodologies  What you'll be measured on  Relationship health, documented ROI delivered for each account, platform adoption rates, onboarding time-to-value, and commercial expansion. You'll own the full customer health picture — not just satisfaction scores. Compensation  Competitive, commensurate with experience. Paid in USD as a contractor engagement.

description:

Junte-se à nossa equipe como professor de inglês remoto! Estamos à procura de pessoas dedicadas e entusiasmadas para se juntarem à nossa equipe como professores de inglês remoto. Esta posição oferece a conveniência de trabalhar de qualquer lugar com horários flexíveis. Sobre nós:  Somos uma escola de idiomas online comprometida em oferecer ensino de inglês de alta qualidade para alunos de todas as idades e contextos. Nossa missão é ensinar os alunos através de experiências de aprendizagem personalizadas, utilizando a abordagem comunicativa, com foco na fluência mais do que na precisão, selecionando materiais autênticos e relevantes, e integrando todas as quatro habilidades. Visão geral da posição  Lecionar aulas de inglês, principalmente particulares ou em pequenos grupos. Desenvolver planos de aula e atividades envolventes que atendam a diferentes necessidades de aprendizagem e níveis de proficiência, usando a abordagem comunicativa, focada na autonomia do aluno e na personalização da aula. Participar de treinamentos, reuniões com nossos coordenadores e projetos diversos. Fornecer feedback construtivo e ajudar os alunos a melhorar suas habilidades linguísticas. Enviar relatórios das aulas para manter seus alunos e a escola atualizados sobre o andamento das mesmas. Promover um ambiente de aprendizagem confortável e encorajador com foco no sucesso do alu no.  Formato  Contratação:  Contrato com Microempreendedor Individual (MEI) Local : Remoto Carga Horária:  Você define a sua própria agenda  Requisitos  Proficiência em inglês (mínimo C1) Bacharel em Inglês, Educação, Linguística ou áreas similares (certificação TESOL/TEFL é um diferencial). Experiência comprovada no ensino de inglês como segunda língua, seja online ou em sala de aula. Disponibilidade de pelo menos 25 horas/semana, com alguns horários após as 17h (horário de São Paulo). Habilidades de comunicação e de relacionamento interpessoal. Conexão de internet estável, computador, webcam, espaço de trabalho privado e silencioso. Familiaridade com plataformas de ensino online. CNPJ / MEI ativo.  Por que se juntar à nós?  Flexibilidade: Trabalhe de qualquer lugar com um horário flexível que se adapte ao seu estilo de vida. Impacto: Fazer a diferença na vida dos alunos, ajudando-os a atingir seus objetivos de aprendizagem. Crescimento Profissional: Acesso a oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional e treinamento contínuo para aprimorar suas habilidades de ensino. Comunidade de Apoio: Junte-se a uma equipe de educadores que se dedicam ao sucesso dos alunos e à melhoria contínua.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German)
description:

About Turing:  Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies. Role Overview:  We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world! What does day-to-day look like:  You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn: Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?) In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.  Requirements:  Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)  Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities. Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours. Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.  Preferred Qualifications:  Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area. Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.) Understanding of Excel and Google Suite. Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.  Perks of Freelancing With Turing:  Work in a fully remote environment. Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies. Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.  Offer Details:  Engagement type :  Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave) Commitments Required :  Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles  Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Technical Support Engineer em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

About Theta Data  Theta Data is a pioneering data company specializing in low-latency APIs for delivering high-speed options and stocks data. Our mission is to empower users with real-time, actionable information to make well-informed decisions in dynamic financial markets. With a focus on speed and broad data coverage, Theta Data stands at the forefront of the options data industry by providing essential tools and insights. We are dedicated to equipping professionals with the resources needed to excel in a competitive landscape. We’re a small, nimble team growing quickly. Our platform handles billions of database requests daily, and we’re just getting started. The complexity of our data problems is real: tick-level options data is among the most intricate financial data to store, index, and serve at scale. We take engineering seriously. The Role  We're hiring a Technical Support Engineer to be the front line of the customer experience at Theta Data. This is not a generic helpdesk role. Our customers are quantitative researchers, developers, and traders who ask technically sophisticated questions about financial data, APIs, and data integrity. You'll need to understand what they're asking and diagnose problems in depth. Your primary responsibility is to monitor Intercom and Discord to identify, triage, and respond to customer issues as they come in. When you can resolve an issue or provide a working workaround, you do it. When you can't, write a clear, well-documented Jira ticket and escalate to Engineering with everything they need to act quickly, and track the ticket's progress until it's complete. We believe the most important feature is the one the customer already paid for. We take this promise seriously, and we want someone who will, too! What You'll Do  Monitor Intercom and Discord and respond to incoming customer issues in a timely manner Diagnose technical problems related to API behavior, data quality, authentication, request handling, and account set-up Write and run Python scripts to reproduce issues and validate data against expected behavior Make REST API calls to investigate and isolate bugs or unexpected responses Provide workarounds and clear guidance to customers where possible Write thorough, reproducible Jira tickets and escalate unresolved issues Identify recurring issues and surface patterns to help prioritize fixes Create and maintain internal documentation on common issues, workarounds, and resolution steps  What We're Looking For  Required  Experience working in a technical support or customer-facing engineering role Comfort working with REST APIs, including reading documentation, making requests, and interpreting responses Working knowledge of Python for scripting, data inspection, and reproducing issues Strong written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both customers and engineers Detail-oriented and systematic approach to diagnosing problems Weekend support rotation  Nice to Have  Prior experience with financial data APIs Familiarity with financial data concepts (options, equities, market data, OHLCV, Greeks, etc.) Familiarity with Jira or similar issue tracking tools Experience with Intercom or similar support platforms Exposure to SQL or database queries for data validation  Why Theta Data  Rapid growth: the platform and team are both scaling fast Real challenges: data at scale, low-latency systems, complex financial data High ownership: a small team means your decisions matter; you will influence how we operate Remote-first: work from anywhere Direct impact: your work reaches thousands of quants and researchers daily A role that rewards genuine curiosity about financial data and technical problem-solving

Overview  We are seeking an experienced Head of Compliance & MLRO to oversee the company's compliance and regulatory responsibilities in Brazil. This role will support the business in maintaining a strong compliance culture, managing regulatory relationships, and ensuring alignment with applicable legal and regulatory requirements. Working closely with local and regional stakeholders, the successful candidate will provide practical compliance guidance while supporting the company's growth and licensing initiatives in Brazil. Key Responsibilities  Serve as the designated MLRO and lead compliance representative for the Brazil business. Oversee the company's compliance, AML/CFT, sanctions, and financial crime programs. Monitor regulatory developments and provide guidance on relevant regulatory requirements. Maintain relationships with regulators and support regulatory enquiries, reviews, and examinations. Support licensing, registration, and other regulatory initiatives as required. Provide compliance advice to business and operational teams on new products, services, and business activities. Help ensure policies, procedures, and controls remain effective and aligned with regulatory expectations. Oversee key compliance processes, including customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting. Identify compliance risks and work with stakeholders to implement appropriate controls and solutions. Prepare compliance updates and reporting for management. Deliver compliance training and promote a strong culture of compliance across the organization. Collaborate with regional and global teams on compliance-related matters.  Requirements  Bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Business, Accounting, or a related field. Experience in Compliance, AML/Financial Crime, Regulatory Affairs, or a related function within financial services, fintech, payments, banking, or digital assets. Prior experience as an MLRO, Compliance Officer, or similar compliance role is preferred. Good understanding of Brazilian regulatory requirements and AML/CFT obligations. Experience interacting with regulators, auditors, or other external stakeholders is advantageous. Exposure to licensing, regulatory approvals, or compliance projects is beneficial. Experience within digital assets, fintech, payments, or financial institutions is preferred. Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently in a dynamic and evolving environment. Professional certifications such as CAMS, ICA, CFE, or equivalent are a plus. Fluency in English and Portuguese.  Vision & Mission  OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

For our international customer in Valencia, we are looking for a ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer. The role focuses on ongoing APM data maintenance in ServiceNow (APM/CMDB-related records as applicable), identifying data gaps and inconsistencies, coordinating updates with application/service owners, and tracking technical debt indicators and remediation progress.  EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates need to be based in Valencia or willing to relocate to Valencia. Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required. Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English. Tasks and responsibilities:  Perform ongoing maintenance of Application Portfolio Management (APM) data within ServiceNow, including application inventory, ownership, lifecycle status, technology attributes, and documented integrations/dependencies, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency; Identify and remediate data quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders; Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications; Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging ServiceNow portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps; Maintain a centralized log or aligned ServiceNow records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization; Develop and deliver recurring dashboards, reports, and portfolio insights for the onsite Enterprise Architect, including technical debt trends, aging remediation items, progress tracking, and portfolio risk hotspots; Translate stakeholder inputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials; Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices;  Profile:  Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline; +8 years of overall experience in Information Technology; +3 years of experience supporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams; Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting; Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize); Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights; Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making; Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates; Previous experience delivering similar ServiceNow APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred; Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail; AI literacy, including practical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks; Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders; Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:   Detalhes da vaga  -CLT + Benefícios -Modelo de atuação: Remoto Sobre a Oportunidade  Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista FinOps Sênior para atuar na governança financeira de ambientes Cloud Azure, contribuindo diretamente para a otimização de custos, eficiência operacional e tomada de decisão estratégica da organização. O profissional será responsável por analisar, monitorar e otimizar os investimentos em nuvem, atuando em parceria com áreas de Engenharia, Arquitetura, Infraestrutura, Produtos, Finanças e Liderança Executiva. Buscamos alguém com forte capacidade analítica, visão estratégica e habilidade para transformar dados financeiros e operacionais em insights acionáveis que gerem valor para o negócio.   Principais Responsabilidades  Gestão Financeira e Governança Cloud Realizar análises detalhadas de custos em ambientes Microsoft Azure, identificando oportunidades de otimização e eficiência financeira; Estruturar e manter processos de governança financeira para ambientes cloud; Desenvolver e acompanhar estratégias de alocação, rateio e rastreabilidade de custos (showback e chargeback); Garantir a correta utilização de tags, grupos de recursos e estruturas financeiras para atribuição de custos; Revisar taxonomias de recursos e propor melhorias para aumentar a visibilidade e controle financeiro dos ambientes. Planejamento Financeiro e Forecast Construir previsões de consumo e gastos cloud utilizando dados históricos e tendências de utilização; Apoiar processos de orçamento, planejamento financeiro e acompanhamento de despesas (Forecast x Realizado); Mapear oportunidades de savings e contribuir na construção de planos financeiros anuais; Avaliar impactos financeiros de novos projetos, arquiteturas e workloads; Apoiar análises de ROI, TCO e viabilidade financeira de iniciativas em nuvem. Monitoramento, Indicadores e Reporting Criar dashboards executivos e operacionais para acompanhamento de custos, consumo e indicadores FinOps; Desenvolver relatórios gerenciais e análises estratégicas para suporte à tomada de decisão; Implementar alertas e monitoramentos automatizados para controle de desvios orçamentários; Participar de reuniões periódicas de revisão de custos junto às áreas técnicas e executivas; Atuar em comitês de FinOps, governança e gestão orçamentária. Suporte aos Times Técnicos Atuar como parceiro dos times de Engenharia, Arquitetura, Infraestrutura e Produtos na gestão eficiente dos recursos cloud; Promover boas práticas de consumo, otimização e governança financeira; Garantir aderência às políticas corporativas relacionadas ao uso dos recursos em nuvem. ✅ Requisitos Obrigatórios  Cloud & Azure Conhecimento avançado em Microsoft Azure; Experiência com:Azure Cost Management Azure Advisor Reservations Azure Policies Management Groups Billing Accounts Resource Groups FinOps & Governança Financeira Experiência sólida com práticas e frameworks FinOps; Gestão de Showback e Chargeback; Alocação e rateio de custos cloud; Controle orçamentário e gestão de Forecast; Construção de modelos financeiros para ambientes cloud; Análise de custos por produto, unidade de negócio, projeto ou centro de custo; Definição e gestão de taxonomias e estratégias de tagging. Dados e Análises Construção de dashboards e indicadores gerenciais; Análise de tendências de consumo e otimização de recursos; Interpretação de indicadores financeiros e operacionais; Experiência na geração de relatórios executivos.
